meaning: s. forsaken by owner or inhabitants; s. free from constraint
translation_zh: a. 被抛弃的, 无约束的, 恣意放荡的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常被放弃的的解释。

meaning: r. in an abnormal manner
translation_zh: adv. 不正常, 异常, (贬)不同寻常, 不规则, 变态, 反常
example: The weather was abnormally warm for this time of year.

meaning: v. do away with
translation_zh: vt. 废止, 革除, 消灭；[经] 废除, 取消, 裁撤
example: The government plans to abolish the tax next year.

meaning: a. of or pertaining to members of the indigenous people of Australia; s. having existed from the beginning; in an earliest or original stage or state
translation_zh: a. 原始的, 土著的；n. 土著居民, 土生生物
example: The aboriginal peoples of Australia have a rich culture.

meaning: r. quickly and without warning
translation_zh: adv. 突然地, 唐突地
example: The car stopped abruptly.

meaning: n. one that is absent or not in residence
translation_zh: n. 缺席者, 不在者；[经] 缺勤者, 缺席者, 未到工者
example: The teacher marked the absentee in her register.

meaning: n. a situation in which life seems irrational and meaningless; s. inconsistent with reason or logic or common sense; s. incongruous; inviting ridicule
translation_zh: a. 荒谬的, 不合理的, 可笑的；n. 荒诞
example: That's an absurd idea.

meaning: n. a rude expression intended to offend or hurt; v. use foul or abusive language towards; v. use wrongly or improperly or excessively
translation_zh: n. 滥用, 虐待, 恶习, 辱骂；vt. 滥用, 辱骂, 虐待
example: The report detailed cases of child abuse.

meaning: n the quality of being at hand when needed; n the attribute of being easy to meet or deal with
translation_zh: n. 易接近, 可进入；[化] 可及性; 可达性; 可接近性; 吸湿性
example: The new building was designed with full accessibility for people with disabilities.

meaning: n. a settlement of differences; n. in the theories of Jean Piaget: the modification of internal representations in order to accommodate a changing knowledge of reality; n. living quarters provided for public convenience; n. the act of providing something (lodging or seat or food) to meet a need
translation_zh: n. 膳宿, 预订铺位, 适应性调节, 调和, 贷款；[医] 调节(眼); 适应
example: 这个住处为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in accordance with
translation_zh: adv. 相应地, 因此, 于是
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. collect or gather
translation_zh: v. 积聚, 堆积
example: 我们需要逐步accumulate这个方案。

meaning: n. a formal charge of wrongdoing brought against a person; the act of imputing blame or guilt; n. an assertion that someone is guilty of a fault or offence
translation_zh: n. 控告, 指控, 指责；[法] 控告, 起诉, 告发
example: He denied the accusation of theft.

meaning: s capable of existing or taking place or proving true; possible to do
translation_zh: a. 做得成的, 可完成的, 可有成就的
example: Setting realistic goals makes them more achievable.

meaning: n. any of various water-soluble compounds having a sour taste and capable of turning litmus red and reacting with a base to form a salt; n. street name for lysergic acid diethylamide; s. having the characteristics of an acid
translation_zh: n. 酸, 酸类物质, 尖刻, 迷幻药；a. 酸的, 酸性的, 尖刻的, 敏锐的；[计] 自动文档互参与索引生成程序
example: Lemon juice is an acid.

meaning: n. the act of contracting or assuming or acquiring possession of something; n. something acquired
translation_zh: n. 获得, 获得物；[经] 收购, 招揽, 取得
example: 这个获得为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in an active manner
translation_zh: adv. 活跃地, 积极地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. having or experiencing a rapid onset and short but severe course; s. extremely sharp or intense; s. having or demonstrating ability to recognize or draw fine distinctions; a. of an angle; less than 90 degrees
translation_zh: a. 尖锐的, 敏锐的, 激烈的, 严重的, 急性的；[医] 急性的; 尖锐的
example: She has an acute sense of smell.

meaning: a. capable of adapting (of becoming or being made suitable) to a particular situation or use
translation_zh: a. 能适应的, 适合的, 可修改的
example: He is an adaptable person who can work in any environment.

meaning: n. someone who is so ardently devoted to something that it resembles an addiction; n. someone who is physiologically dependent on a substance; abrupt deprivation of the substance produces withdrawal symptoms; v. to cause (someone or oneself) to become dependent (on something, especially a narcotic drug)
translation_zh: vt. 使沉溺, 使上瘾；n. 入迷的人, 上瘾者
example: He was addicted to gambling.

meaning: a. compulsively or physiologically dependent on something habit-forming
translation_zh: a. 沉溺于...的, 无法摆脱(某种嗜好)的；[法] 嗜, 好, 惯于
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（吸毒）成瘾的的解释。

meaning: n. being abnormally tolerant to and dependent on something that is psychologically or physically habit-forming (especially alcohol or narcotic drugs); n. an abnormally strong craving; n. (Roman law) a formal award by a magistrate of a thing or person to another person (as the award of a debtor to his creditor); a surrender to a master
translation_zh: n. 入迷, 瘾；[医] 瘾, 癖嗜
example: He is trying to overcome his addiction to sugar.

meaning: r. in addition, by way of addition; furthermore
translation_zh: adv. 另外, 此外
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. having the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task; s. sufficient for the purpose; s. about average; acceptable
translation_zh: a. 适当的, 足够的；[法] 胜任的, 适当的, 充分的
example: The food supply was adequate for everyone.

meaning: r. in an adequate manner or to an adequate degree
translation_zh: adv. 足够地, 适当地
example: 他充分地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. making or becoming suitable; adjusting to circumstances; n. the act of adjusting something to match a standard
translation_zh: n. 调整, 调节, 校正；[化] 调节
example: She made a small adjustment to the settings.

meaning: a. of or relating to or responsible for administration
translation_zh: a. 管理的, 行政的；[法] 行政的, 管理的, 遗产管理的
example: He works in the administrative department.

meaning: s. deserving of the highest esteem or admiration; s. inspiring admiration or approval
translation_zh: a. 可钦佩的, 极好的, 令人惊奇的
example: Her dedication to the cause is truly admirable.

meaning: r. with admiration
translation_zh: adv. 钦佩地, 羡慕地
example: 他赞赏的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: r as acknowledged
translation_zh: adv. 公认地, 诚然
example: Admittedly, I was wrong about that.

meaning: a. acquired as your own by free choice
translation_zh: a. 被收养的, 被采用的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常被收养的的解释。

meaning: n. the act of accepting with approval; favorable reception; n. a legal proceeding that creates a parent-child relation between persons not related by blood; the adopted child is entitled to all privileges belonging to a natural child of the adoptive parents (including the right to inherit)
translation_zh: n. 采用, 采纳, 收养；[法] 收养, 采纳, 采用
example: 这个采用为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. love intensely
translation_zh: vt. 崇拜, 爱慕, 喜爱；vi. 崇拜, 爱慕
example: 我们需要逐步adore这个方案。

meaning: v make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.; v be beautiful to look at; v furnish with power or authority; of kings or emperors
translation_zh: vt. 装饰, 使生色
example: 我们需要逐步adorn这个方案。

meaning: n. gradual improvement or growth or development
translation_zh: n. 前进, 进步, 提升；[医] 徙前术
example: Her rapid advancement in the company was impressive.

meaning: n. arrival that has been awaited (especially of something momentous); n. the season including the four Sundays preceding Christmas
translation_zh: n. 来到, 来临
example: The advent of the internet changed everything.

meaning: a. willing to undertake or seeking out new and daring enterprises
translation_zh: a. 喜欢冒险的, 有进取心的, 危险的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常爱冒险的的解释。

meaning: s. contrary to your interests or welfare; s. in an opposing direction
translation_zh: a. 不利的, 敌对的, 相反的, 逆的；[法] 相反的, 敌对的, 逆的
example: The company faced adverse economic conditions.

meaning: r. in an adverse manner
translation_zh: adv. 不利, 有害, 相反, 逆, 敌对, 逆向
example: 他逆地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a state of misfortune or affliction; n. a stroke of ill fortune; a calamitous event
translation_zh: n. 逆境, 不幸, 灾祸, 灾难
example: 这个逆境为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. having or displaying warmth or affection
translation_zh: a. 深情的, 充满情爱的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常深情的的解释。

meaning: r with affection
translation_zh: adv. 挚爱地, 亲切地
example: She smiled affectionately at her grandchild.

meaning: s that you have the financial means for
translation_zh: [计] 普及型
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常付得起的的解释。

meaning: s. continuing forever or indefinitely
translation_zh: a. 不老的, 永恒的
example: Her beauty seemed ageless, defying the passage of time.

meaning: r. in an aggressive manner
translation_zh: adv. (贬)侵略, 侵犯, 寻衅, (褒)敢作敢为, 有进取心, (武器)攻击性, 过分, 放肆
example: 他侵略地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. intense feelings of suffering; acute mental or physical pain; n. a state of acute pain
translation_zh: n. 极大的痛苦, 挣扎；[医] 濒死苦闷; 剧痛
example: He was in agony after the accident.

meaning: n. a vehicle that can fly
translation_zh: n. 航空器, 飞机；[机] 航空器
example: The aircraft landed safely on the runway.

meaning: n. the crew of an aircraft
translation_zh: n. 空勤组
example: 这个aircrew（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. habitual intoxication; prolonged and excessive intake of alcoholic drinks leading to a breakdown in health and an addiction to alcohol such that abrupt deprivation leads to severe withdrawal symptoms
translation_zh: n. 酗酒, 酒精中毒；[化] 酒中毒
example: Alcoholism is a serious disease that affects many families.

meaning: n. condition of heightened watchfulness or preparation for action; n. a warning serves to make you more alert to danger; a. engaged in or accustomed to close observation; s. quick and energetic
translation_zh: a. 警觉的, 灵敏的, 留心的；n. 警报；vt. 使警觉, 通知, 使意识到
example: 我们需要逐步alert这个方案。

meaning: n. (law) a formal accusation against somebody (often in a court of law); n. statements affirming or denying certain matters of fact that you are prepared to prove
translation_zh: n. 断言, 主张, 申辩；[法] 声明, 事实陈述, 断言
example: The police are investigating an allegation of fraud.

meaning: n. the state of being allied or confederated; n. a connection based on kinship or marriage or common interest; n. an organization of people (or countries) involved in a pact or treaty; n. a formal agreement establishing an association or alliance between nations or other groups to achieve a particular aim
translation_zh: n. 联盟, 联合；[法] 同盟, 联盟, 联姻
example: The two countries formed an alliance.

meaning: n. a friendly nation; n. an associate who provides cooperation or assistance; v. become an ally or associate, as by a treaty or marriage
translation_zh: n. 同盟者, 同盟国, 助手；vt. 使联盟, 使联合, 使有关系；vi. 结盟
example: They became close allies during the war.

meaning: r side by side
translation_zh: adv. 在旁边, 靠拢着；prep. 在...旁边, 与...在一起
example: 这个ad为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a relating to or expressed by a writing system that uses an alphabet; a arranged in order according to the alphabet
translation_zh: a. 依字母顺序的, 字母的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常按字母(表)顺序的副 词:alphabetically的解释。

meaning: n. the table in Christian churches where communion is given; n. a raised structure on which gifts or sacrifices to a god are made
translation_zh: n. 圣坛, 祭坛
example: The bride and groom stood before the altar.

meaning: v. make an alteration to; v. remove the ovaries of
translation_zh: v. 改变
example: 我们需要逐步alter这个方案。

meaning: v. go back and forth; swing back and forth between two states or conditions; v. exchange people temporarily to fulfill certain jobs and functions; v. do something in turns; s. every second one of a series
translation_zh: a. 交替的, 轮流的, 间隔的；v. 轮流, (使)交替
example: We meet on alternate Tuesdays.

meaning: r. in place of, or as an alternative to
translation_zh: adv. 非此即彼
example: 他非此即彼地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. elevation especially above sea level or above the earth's surface; n. the perpendicular distance from the base of a geometric figure to the opposite vertex (or side if parallel)
translation_zh: n. 高度, 海拔, 高处；[电] 高度
example: The airplane reached an altitude of 30,000 feet.

meaning: v. affect with wonder
translation_zh: vt. 使吃惊
example: 我们需要逐步amaze这个方案。

meaning: n the feeling that accompanies something extremely surprising
translation_zh: n. 惊愕, 惊异
example: 这个惊奇为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in an amazing manner; to everyone's surprise
translation_zh: adv. 令人惊讶地；惊奇地
example: 他令人惊奇地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a diplomat of the highest rank; accredited as representative from one country to another; n. an informal representative
translation_zh: n. 大使；[法] 大使, 使节, 代理
example: The ambassador delivered a speech.

meaning: n. an expression whose meaning cannot be determined from its context; n. unclearness by virtue of having more than one meaning
translation_zh: n. 不明确, 含糊；[计] 二义性; 多义性
example: There was some ambiguity in his statement.

meaning: a. having more than one possible meaning; s. having no intrinsic or objective meaning; not organized in conventional patterns
translation_zh: a. 不明确的, 模棱两可的；[法] 意思含糊的, 模棱两可的, 暧昧的
example: The instructions were ambiguous and difficult to follow.

meaning: n. a pungent gas compounded of nitrogen and hydrogen (NH3)
translation_zh: n. 氨水, 阿摩尼亚；[化] 氨
example: Ammonia is often used in cleaning products.

meaning: prep. Mixed or mingled; surrounded by.; prep. Conjoined, or associated with, or making part of the; number of; in the number or class of.; prep. Expressing a relation of dispersion, distribution,; etc.; also, a relation of reciprocal action.
translation_zh: prep. 在...当中, 在...之间, 在...之中
example: 这个（表示位置）处在…中为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. more than enough in size or scope or capacity; s. affording an abundant supply; s. fairly large
translation_zh: a. 大量的, 充足的, 丰富的
example: There was ample time to finish the project.

meaning: n. electronic equipment that increases strength of signals passing through it
translation_zh: n. 扩大的人(物), 放大器, 扩音器；[计] 放大器
example: He connected his guitar to the amplifier to make it louder.

meaning: v. increase the volume of
translation_zh: vt. 增强, 放大, 扩大, 详述；vi. 引伸
example: 我们需要逐步amplify这个方案。

meaning: v. occupy in an agreeable, entertaining or pleasant fashion; v. make (somebody) laugh
translation_zh: vt. 消遣, 娱乐, 使发笑
example: 我们需要逐步amuse这个方案。

meaning: n. an inference that if things agree in some respects they probably agree in others; n. drawing a comparison in order to show a similarity in some respect
translation_zh: n. 相似, 类似；[计] 模拟
example: He drew an analogy between the human heart and a pump.

meaning: n. someone who is skilled at analyzing data; n. an expert who studies financial data (on credit or securities or sales or financial patterns etc.) and recommends appropriate business actions; n. a licensed practitioner of psychoanalysis
translation_zh: n. 分析者, 精神分析学家；[化] 分析员; 化验员
example: She works as a financial analyst for a large bank.

meaning: n. a mechanical device that prevents a vessel from moving; n. a central cohesive source of support and stability; n. a television reporter who coordinates a broadcast to which several correspondents contribute; v. fix firmly and stably
translation_zh: n. 锚；vt. 抛锚停泊, 使固定；[计] 锚
example: 这个锚给人安全感的物(或人)为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the condition of being secured to a base; n. a fee for anchoring; n. a city in south central Alaska; n. place for vessels to anchor
translation_zh: n. 下锚, 锚地, 停泊税；[化] 固着; 固定; 锚定
example: 这个锚地为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a television reporter who coordinates a broadcast to which several correspondents contribute
translation_zh: n. 末棒运动员, 成绩倒数第一名, 新闻节目主持人
example: The anchorman delivered the evening news with a serious tone.

meaning: n a television reporter who coordinates a broadcast to which several correspondents contribute
translation_zh: n. 新闻节目主持人
example: 这个anchorperson（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. extreme mental distress; n. extreme distress of body or mind; v. suffer great pains or distress
translation_zh: n. 剧痛, 痛苦；vt. 使极痛苦；vi. 感到痛苦
example: 这个痛苦为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. give new life or energy to; a. belonging to the class of nouns that denote living beings; a. endowed with animal life as distinguished from plant life
translation_zh: vt. 使有生气, 赋予生命；a. 有生命的, 有生气的
example: 我们需要逐步animate这个方案。

meaning: a. having no known name or identity or known source; s. not known or lacking marked individuality
translation_zh: a. 姓氏不详的, 无名的, 无特色的；[计] 无记录
example: The donation was made by an anonymous donor.

meaning: n. artillery designed to shoot upward at airplanes; s. designed for defense from a surface position against air attack
translation_zh: a. 防空的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常antiaircraft（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n. any drug that destroys bacteria or inhibits their growth; a. destroying bacteria or inhibiting their growth
translation_zh: a. 抗菌的；n. 抗菌剂
example: This soap has antibacterial properties.

meaning: a used in the treatment of cancer
translation_zh: a. [医]抗癌的
example: 这个anticancer（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. act in advance of; deal with ahead of time; v. realize beforehand; v. be excited or anxious about; v. be a forerunner of or occur earlier than
translation_zh: vt. 预期, 占先, 加速, 提前使用；[医] 提前出现, 先期发生
example: We anticipate a busy holiday season.

meaning: n. an expectation; n. something expected (as on the basis of a norm); n. anticipating with confidence of fulfillment
translation_zh: n. 预期, 预料；[医] 提前出现(如遗传病)
example: There was a sense of anticipation in the air before the concert.

meaning: a intended to reduce pollution
translation_zh: a. 防止环境污染的, 防污染的
example: 这个antipollution（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any piece of furniture or decorative object or the like produced in a former period and valuable because of its beauty or rarity; v. shop for antiques; v. give an antique appearance to; s. made in or typical of earlier times and valued for its age
translation_zh: n. 古董, 古物；a. 古老的, 古风的, 旧式的, 过时的
example: She collects antique furniture.

meaning: antistatic
translation_zh: a. 抗静电的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常antistatic（adjective）的解释。

meaning: software designed to protect against computer viruses
translation_zh: n. 抗病毒素；[医] 细菌滤液
example: You should install antivirus software on your computer.

meaning: n. address to an absent or imaginary person; n. the mark (') used to indicate the omission of one or more letters from a printed word
translation_zh: n. 撇号, 呼语法
example: 这个省略符号为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person who requests or seeks something such as assistance or employment or admission
translation_zh: n. 申请者；[经] 申请人, 请求人, 谋事人
example: 这个申请人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. feeling or expressive of gratitude; s. having or showing appreciation or a favorable critical judgment or opinion
translation_zh: a. 有欣赏力的, 感激的
example: She was very appreciative of his help.

meaning: r. in an appropriate manner
translation_zh: adv. 适当的, 恰如其分的, 恰当的, 合适的
example: 他适当地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. be close or similar; s. not quite exact or correct; s. very close in resemblance; s. located close together
translation_zh: a. 大约的, 接近的, 近似的；vt. 接近, 使接近, 粗略估计；vi. 接近于
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常近似的的解释。

meaning: n. a curved shape in the vertical plane that spans an opening; n. a curved bony structure supporting or enclosing organs (especially the inner sides of the feet); n. a passageway under a curved masonry construction; n. (architecture) a masonry construction (usually curved) for spanning an opening and supporting the weight above it
translation_zh: n. 拱门, 拱形, 足弓；vt. 使成弓形；vi. 拱起, 成弓形；a. 主要的, 调皮的, 傲慢无礼的, 狡猾的
example: 这个弓形为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the regions to the north of the Arctic Circle centered on the North Pole; n. a waterproof overshoe that protects shoes from water or snow; s. extremely cold
translation_zh: a. 北极的, 极寒的；n. 北极圈, 北极
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常北极的 n. 北极的解释。

meaning: n. the central area of an ancient Roman amphitheater where contests and spectacles were held; especially an area that was strewn with sand; n. a playing field where sports events take place
translation_zh: n. 角斗场, 舞台, 场地；[医] 尿沉渣, 尿沙; 脑沙
example: 这个舞台为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a privileged class holding hereditary titles; n the most powerful members of a society
translation_zh: n. 贵族, 上层社会, 知识界杰出分子；[法] 贵族政治, 贵族统治
example: The aristocracy once held significant power in many European countries.

meaning: n. the quantity that can be contained in the arms
translation_zh: n. 一抱之量
example: 这个armful（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. call forth (emotions, feelings, and responses); v. to begin moving, "As the thunder started the sleeping children began to stir"; v. stimulate sexually

meaning: n. a tract of land used for burials
translation_zh: n. 墓地, 公墓；[法] 公墓, 墓地
example: 这个墓地为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. of or relating to a temperature scale on which the freezing point of water is 0 degrees and the boiling point of water is 100 degrees
translation_zh: a. 百分度的, 摄氏的；[医] 百分度
example: 这个摄氏的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts; v. present someone with a certificate; v. authorize by certificate
translation_zh: n. 证书, 证明书；vt. 发给证明书, 用证书批准, 用证书证明
example: 这个证明书为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of certifying or bestowing a franchise on
translation_zh: n. 证明；[经] 证明
example: She received her teaching certification last year.

meaning: v. guarantee payment on; of checks; v. guarantee as meeting a certain standard; v. declare legally insane
translation_zh: v. 证明, 保证
example: The doctor will certify your medical condition.

meaning: n. the person who is head of state (in several countries); n. the honorary or titular head of a university
translation_zh: n. 大臣, 总理, 首相, 大使馆/领事馆的一等秘书, 司法官, 大学校长
example: 这个总理（德、奥等的）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. lacking a visible order or organization; s. completely unordered and unpredictable and confusing; a. of or relating to a sensitive dependence on initial conditions
translation_zh: a. 混乱的, 无秩序的；[法] 混乱的, 混沌的
example: The traffic was chaotic after the accident.

meaning: n. a distinguishing quality; n. the integer part (positive or negative) of the representation of a logarithm; in the expression log 643 = 2.808 the characteristic is 2; n. any measurable property of a device measured under closely specified conditions; a. typical or distinctive
translation_zh: n. 特性, 特征, 特色；a. 特性的, 特有的, 有特色的；[计] 阶; 指数
example: A key characteristic of the species is its long tail.

meaning: s. pleasing or delighting; s. possessing or using or characteristic of or appropriate to supernatural powers
translation_zh: a. 迷人的, 有吸引力的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常迷人的的解释。

meaning: n. a deception for profit to yourself; v. deprive somebody of something by deceit; v. defeat someone through trickery or deceit; v. engage in deceitful behavior; practice trickery or fraud
translation_zh: n. 欺骗, 作弊, 骗子；v. 欺骗, 逃脱, 骗取
example: 我们需要逐步cheat这个方案。

meaning: n. a place (as at a frontier) where travellers are stopped for inspection and clearance
translation_zh: n. 检查站；[计] 检查点
example: Soldiers stopped the car at the military checkpoint.

meaning: s offensively bold
translation_zh: a. 厚颜的, 无耻的, 色情的
example: The child gave a cheeky grin.

meaning: r. in a cheerful manner
translation_zh: adv. 高高兴兴地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the quality of being cheerful and dispelling gloom; n. a feeling of spontaneous good spirits
translation_zh: n. 高兴, 快活
example: 这个高兴为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the use of chemical agents to treat or control disease (or mental illness)
translation_zh: n. 化学疗法；[化] 化学疗法
example: 这个<医>化学疗法为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. characterized by feeling or showing fond affection for
translation_zh: v. 珍爱( cherish的过去式和过去分词 ); 怀有; 爱护; 抚育
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常珍爱( cherish的过去式和过去分词 )的解释。

meaning: n. wood of any of various cherry trees especially the black cherry; n. any of numerous trees and shrubs producing a small fleshy round fruit with a single hard stone; many also produce a valuable hardwood; n. a red fruit with a single hard stone
translation_zh: n. 樱桃, 樱桃树, 樱桃色；[医] 樱桃
example: 这个樱桃为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a wad of something chewable as tobacco; n. biting and grinding food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow; v. chew (food); to bite and grind with the teeth
translation_zh: vt. 咀嚼, 嚼碎；vi. 咀嚼, 细想；n. 咀嚼, 咀嚼物
example: 我们需要逐步chew这个方案。

meaning: s. indicating a lack of maturity
translation_zh: a. 天真的, 孩子气的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常幼稚的的解释。

meaning: n. a vertical flue that provides a path through which smoke from a fire is carried away through the wall or roof of a building
translation_zh: n. 烟囱, 灯罩；[电] 烟囱
example: 这个烟囱为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a triangular wooden float attached to the end of a log line; n. a piece of dried bovine dung; n. a thin crisp slice of potato fried in deep fat; n. a small disk-shaped counter used to represent money when gambling
translation_zh: n. 屑片, 薄片, 碎片；vt. 削, 切, 削成碎片, 使摔倒, 凿；vi. 削下屑片；[计] 孔屑; 组件; 晶片; 芯片
example: 这个碎片缺口炸马铃薯条集成电路片为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the irregular motion of waves (usually caused by wind blowing in a direction opposite to the tide); n. a small cut of meat including part of a rib; n. a jaw; n. a tennis return made with a downward motion that puts backspin on the ball
translation_zh: n. 肋条肉, 排骨, 砍, 戳记, 商标；vt. 剁碎, 砍, 切击, 割断；vi. 砍, 突然转向
example: 我们需要逐步chop这个方案。

meaning: n. a substantial amount
translation_zh: n. 大块, 矮胖的人(或物)；[经] 定样
example: 这个大块为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an electrical device that provides a path for electrical current to flow; n. an established itinerary of venues or events that a particular group of people travel to; n. (law) a judicial division of a state or the United States (so-called because originally judges traveled and held court in different locations); one of the twelve groups of states in the United States that is covered by a particular circuit court of appeals; v. make a circuit
translation_zh: n. 电路, 环(行)道, 巡回；[计] 线路; 电路
example: The electrician checked the circuit for any faults.

meaning: n. electronic equipment consisting of a system of circuits
translation_zh: n. 电路学, 电路系统；[电] 一环路
example: 这个电路为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a condition that accompanies or influences some event or activity; n. information that should be kept in mind when making a decision; n. formal ceremony about important occasions
translation_zh: n. 环境, 状况, 事件
example: Under no circumstances should you open that door.

meaning: s. occurring or extending throughout a city
translation_zh: a. 全市的, 全市性的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常全市的的解释。

meaning: n. burrowing marine mollusk living on sand or mud; the shell closes with viselike firmness; n. flesh of either hard-shell or soft-shell clams; v. gather clams, by digging in the sand by the ocean
translation_zh: n. 蛤, 沉默寡言的人；vi. 捞蛤
example: 这个蛤为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. put quickly or forcibly; v. cause to strike the air in flight; v. clap one's hands together; v. strike the air in flight
translation_zh: n. 拍手, 拍手声, 霹雳声, 花柳病；v. 鼓掌, (使)啪地关上
example: 我们需要逐步clap这个方案。

meaning: v. make clear and (more) comprehensible; v. make clear by removing impurities or solids, as by heating
translation_zh: vi. 澄清, 阐明；vt. 使明晰
example: 我们需要逐步clarify这个方案。

meaning: n. a group of people or things arranged by class or category; n. the basic cognitive process of arranging into classes or categories; n. restriction imposed by the government on documents or weapons that are available only to certain authorized people
translation_zh: n. 分类, 分级；[化] 分级; 分粒; 分类
example: The classification of species is complex.

meaning: n. (grammar) an expression including a subject and predicate but not constituting a complete sentence
translation_zh: n. 子句, 条款；[计] 子句
example: Every contract has a termination clause.

meaning: n. the quality of clear water
translation_zh: n. 晴朗, 明白
example: 这个clearness（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. of or relating to clerks; a. of or relating to the clergy; s. appropriate for or engaged in office work
translation_zh: n. 牧师；a. 文书的, 事务上的, 抄写员的, 牧师的
example: She applied for a clerical position at the law firm.

meaning: n. footwear usually with wooden soles; n. any object that acts as a hindrance or obstruction; v. become or cause to become obstructed; v. dance a clog dance
translation_zh: n. 障碍, 脚坠；v. 障碍, 阻塞
example: Hair can easily clog the drain.

meaning: n. a rule for limiting or ending debate in a deliberative body; n. a Gestalt principle of organization holding that there is an innate tendency to perceive incomplete objects as complete and to close or fill gaps and to perceive asymmetric stimuli as symmetric; n. termination of operations; v. terminate debate by calling for a vote
translation_zh: n. 关闭；vt. 使终止
example: The family sought closure after the long legal battle.

meaning: n. a covering designed to be worn on a person's body
translation_zh: n. 衣服
example: 这个衣服为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s lacking grace in movement or posture; s not elegant or graceful in expression; s difficult to handle or manage especially because of shape; s showing lack of skill or aptitude
translation_zh: a. 笨拙的, 不雅观的, 粗陋的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常笨拙的的解释。

meaning: n. the job of a professional coach
translation_zh: n. 辅导；教练技术
example: His coaching helped the team win the championship.

meaning: n. the state of being combined into one body
translation_zh: n. 结合体, 结合, 联合；[经] 联合, 联盟
example: The two parties formed a coalition government.

meaning: a. of textures that are rough to the touch or substances consisting of relatively large particles; s. lacking refinement or cultivation or taste; s. of low or inferior quality or value
translation_zh: a. 粗糙的, 下等的, 粗俗的；[计] 粗略的
example: The fabric felt coarse against her skin.

meaning: n. the outline of a coast
translation_zh: n. 海岸线
example: 这个海岸线为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a short mixed drink; n. an appetizer served as a first course at a meal
translation_zh: n. 鸡尾酒, 开味品；a. 鸡尾酒会的
example: 这个鸡尾酒为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a beverage made from cocoa powder and milk and sugar; usually drunk hot; n. powder of ground roasted cacao beans with most of the fat removed
translation_zh: n. 可可粉, 可可茶, 可可色；[医] 可可, 可可豆
example: 这个可可粉为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the edible white meat of a coconut; often shredded for use in e.g. cakes and curries; n. large hard-shelled oval nut with a fibrous husk containing thick white meat surrounding a central cavity filled (when fresh) with fluid or milk; n. tall palm tree bearing coconuts as fruits; widely planted throughout the tropics
translation_zh: n. 椰子；[医] 椰子(实)
example: 这个植椰子为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the state of cohering or sticking together; n. logical and orderly and consistent relation of parts
translation_zh: n. 黏合(性), 连贯性, 一致性；[化] 相干性
example: The essay lacked coherence and was difficult to follow.

meaning: a. marked by an orderly, logical, and aesthetically consistent relation of parts; s. capable of thinking and expressing yourself in a clear and consistent manner; a. (physics) of waves having a constant phase relation; s. sticking together
translation_zh: a. 互相耦合的, 清晰的, 明了的，凝聚性的, 连贯的
example: His argument was coherent and well-reasoned.

meaning: v. go with, fall together; v. be the same
translation_zh: vi. 一致, 符合；[化] 重合
example: Their holidays happened to coincide.

meaning: n. an event that might have been arranged although it was really accidental; n. the quality of occupying the same position or area in space
translation_zh: n. 巧合, 同时发生；[电] 符合计数器
example: It was a strange coincidence that we both wore the same outfit.

meaning: n. an associate that one works with; n. a person who is member of one's class or profession
translation_zh: n. 同事, 同僚
example: 这个同事为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person who collects things; n. a person who is employed to collect payments (as for rent or taxes); n. a crater that has collected cosmic material hitting the earth; n. the electrode in a transistor through which a primary flow of carriers leaves the region between the electrodes
translation_zh: n. 收集家, 收取款项的人；[化] 集电极; 捕收剂
example: 这个收集者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a grouping of words in a sentence
translation_zh: n. 排列, 搭配, 布置
example: 这个collocation（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the part of the large intestine between the cecum and the rectum; it extracts moisture from food residues before they are excreted; n. the basic unit of money in El Salvador; equal to 100 centavos; n. the basic unit of money in Costa Rica; equal to 100 centimos; n. a port city at the Caribbean entrance to the Panama Canal
translation_zh: n. 冒号, 结肠；[医] 结肠
example: Remember to use a colon before a list of items.

meaning: n. a resident of a colony; a. of or relating to or characteristic of or inhabiting a colony; a. of animals who live in colonies, such as ants; s. composed of many distinct individuals united to form a whole or colony
translation_zh: a. 殖民的, 殖民地的；[法] 殖民地居民
example: Many countries have a colonial past.

meaning: n. a state of deep and often prolonged unconsciousness; usually the result of disease or injury; n. (botany) a usually terminal tuft of bracts (as in the pineapple) or tuft of hairs (especially on certain seeds); n. (astronomy) the luminous cloud of particles surrounding the frozen nucleus of a comet; forms as the comet approaches the sun and is warmed
translation_zh: n. 昏迷, 麻木, 彗发；[化] 彗差; 彗形像差
example: After the accident, he was in a coma for several days.

meaning: r. in mental comfort; without stress; r. in physical comfort
translation_zh: adv. 安乐地, 舒服地, 宽裕地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. someone in an official position of authority who can command or control others; n. a commissioned naval officer who ranks above a lieutenant commander and below a captain
translation_zh: n. 司令官, 指挥官
example: The commander gave the order to advance.

meaning: v. mark by some ceremony or observation; v. call to remembrance; keep alive the memory of someone or something, as in a ceremony; v. be or provide a memorial to a person or an event
translation_zh: vt. 纪念
example: 我们需要逐步commemorate这个方案。

meaning: n. transactions (sales and purchases) having the objective of supplying commodities (goods and services); n. social exchange, especially of opinions, attitudes, etc.
translation_zh: n. 商业, 商务, 贸易；[经] 商业, 贸易, 商务
example: International commerce is vital for global economies.

meaning: n. a fee for services rendered based on a percentage of an amount received or collected or agreed to be paid (as distinguished from a salary); n. the act of granting authority to undertake certain functions; n. the state of being in good working order and ready for operation; n. a formal statement of a command or injunction to do something
translation_zh: n. 委任状, 任官令, 所委职责, 佣金, 犯, 委托, 所托之事；vt. 委任, 委托制作, 使服役
example: The government formed a commission to investigate the issue.

meaning: n. the official name of some states in the United States (Massachusetts and Pennsylvania and Virginia and Kentucky) and associated territories (Puerto Rico); n. a world organization of autonomous states that are united in allegiance to a central power but are not subordinate to it or to one another
translation_zh: n. 共和国；联邦；国民整体
example: The Commonwealth consists of many nations.

meaning: a. of or relating to communication; a. able or tending to communicate
translation_zh: a. 健谈的, 爱说话的, 交际的
example: She is a very communicative person and loves to talk.

meaning: n. a regular journey of some distance to and from your place of work; v. exchange positions without a change in value; v. travel back and forth regularly, as between one's place of work and home; v. exchange a penalty for a less severe one
translation_zh: vt. 交换, 折偿, 减轻；vi. 代偿, 经常乘车来往
example: 我们需要逐步commute这个方案。

meaning: n. a deep awareness of and sympathy for another's suffering; n. the humane quality of understanding the suffering of others and wanting to do something about it
translation_zh: n. 同情, 怜悯
example: She showed great compassion for the victims.

meaning: a. showing or having compassion
translation_zh: a. 慈悲的, 富于同情心的, 照顾性的；vt. 怜悯, 同情
example: She is a compassionate nurse who always cares for her patients.

meaning: a. able to exist and perform in harmonious or agreeable combination; a. capable of being used with or connected to other devices or components without modification; s. capable of forming a homogeneous mixture that neither separates nor is altered by chemical interaction
translation_zh: a. 能共处的, 可并立的, 适合的；[计] 相容的; 兼容的
example: Their personalities are very compatible.

meaning: v. adjust for; v. make amends for; pay compensation for; v. make payment to; compensate
translation_zh: v. 偿还, 补偿, 付报酬
example: They offered to compensate him for the damages.

meaning: n. something (such as money) given or received as payment or reparation (as for a service or loss or injury); n. (psychiatry) a defense mechanism that conceals your undesirable shortcomings by exaggerating desirable behaviors
translation_zh: n. 补偿, 赔偿金, 工资；[医] 代偿(机能), 补偿
example: She received compensation for the damages.

meaning: n. the quality of being adequately or well qualified physically and intellectually
translation_zh: n. 胜任, 职称, 能力；[医] 能力, 活性
example: His competence in the field is undeniable.

meaning: a. properly or sufficiently qualified or capable or efficient; s. adequate for the purpose; a. legally qualified or sufficient
translation_zh: a. 能干的, 胜任的, 有效的, 足够的；[经] 有权的, 授权的, 胜任的
example: She is a very competent manager.

meaning: v. use a computer program to translate source code written in a particular programming language into computer-readable machine code that can be executed
translation_zh: vt. 编译, 编辑, 编纂, 收集；[计] 编译
example: She needs to compile a report by Friday.

meaning: n. (American football) a successful forward pass in football; n. a concluding action
translation_zh: n. 完成；[经] 完井, 结束, 完工
example: The project is nearing completion.

meaning: n. the coloring of a person's face; n. a combination that results from coupling or interlinking; n. a point of view or general attitude or inclination; n. texture and appearance of the skin of the face
translation_zh: n. 肤色, 情况, 局面；[医] 体质; 面色, 面容
example: She has a fair complexion.

meaning: n. the quality of being intricate and compounded
translation_zh: n. 复杂, 复杂性, 复杂的事物
example: The complexity of the problem made it difficult to solve.

meaning: n. an abstract part of something; n. an artifact that is one of the individual parts of which a composite entity is made up; especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system
translation_zh: n. 元件, 组件, 成分；a. 组成的, 构成的；[计] 组件
example: Each component of the machine must work perfectly.

meaning: n. an ability to understand the meaning or importance of something (or the knowledge acquired as a result)
translation_zh: n. 理解, 包含
example: Reading comprehension is a key skill for students.

meaning: a. including all or everything; s. broad in scope
translation_zh: a. 广泛的, 有理解力的, 综合的；[经] 广泛的, 综合的, 全面的
example: The report provides a comprehensive overview.

meaning: n. a cloth pad or dressing (with or without medication) applied firmly to some part of the body (to relieve discomfort or reduce fever); v. make more compact by or as if by pressing; v. squeeze or press together
translation_zh: vt. 压缩, 压紧；vi. 受压缩小；[计] 压缩程序
example: You can compress the file to save space on your hard drive.

meaning: n. the process or result of becoming smaller or pressed together; n. encoding information while reducing the bandwidth or bits required; n. applying pressure
translation_zh: n. 压缩, 压紧；[计] 压缩
example: 这个压缩为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. required by rule
translation_zh: a. 被强制的, 强迫的, 义务的；[经] 强迫的, 强制的
example: Attendance at the meeting is compulsory for all staff.

meaning: v make a mathematical calculation or computation
translation_zh: v. 计算, 估算；n. 计算, 估算
example: The software can compute complex equations in seconds.

meaning: v. hold back; keep from being perceived by others
translation_zh: vt. 隐藏, 掩盖, 隐瞒；[法] 隐瞒, 隐匿, 保守秘密
example: She tried to conceal her true feelings.

meaning: v. admit (to a wrongdoing); v. be willing to concede; v. give over; surrender or relinquish to the physical control of another; v. acknowledge defeat
translation_zh: vt. 承认, 退让；vi. 让步
example: He had to concede that his opponent was right.

meaning: n. an elaborate poetic image or a far-fetched comparison of very dissimilar things; n. a witty or ingenious turn of phrase; n. an artistic device or effect; n. the trait of being unduly vain and conceited; false pride
translation_zh: n. 自负, 空想, 狂妄
example: His conceit made him difficult to work with.

meaning: s. capable of being imagined
translation_zh: a. 想得到的, 可想象的, 可理解的
example: It's conceivable that the project will be finished by next month.

meaning: v. become pregnant; undergo conception
translation_zh: vt. 构思, 认为；vi. 怀孕
example: 我们需要逐步conceive这个方案。

meaning: n. the act of becoming pregnant; fertilization of an ovum by a spermatozoon
translation_zh: n. 观念, 概念；[医] 妊娠, 受孕; 概念
example: The original conception of the project was much simpler.

meaning: v be relevant to; v be on the mind of
translation_zh: prep. 关于；[法] 关于
example: 这个（表示论及）关于为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a contract granting the right to operate a subsidiary business; n. the act of conceding or yielding; n. a point conceded or yielded
translation_zh: n. 特许, 让步, 认可；[经] 核准, 许可, 特殊(权)
example: The company made a concession to the striking workers.

meaning: n. a strong hard building material composed of sand and gravel and cement and water; v. cover with cement; v. form into a solid mass; coalesce; a. capable of being perceived by the senses; not abstract or imaginary
translation_zh: n. 凝结物, 混凝土；a. 具体的, 实在的, 混凝土的；v. (使)凝结, 用混凝土浇筑
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常实在的的解释。

meaning: v. express strong disapproval of; v. declare or judge unfit for use or habitation; v. compel or force into a particular state or activity; v. demonstrate the guilt of (someone)
translation_zh: vt. 判刑, 责备, 谴责；[法] 定罪, 判刑, 宣告有罪
example: The government condemned the terrorist attack.

meaning: n. the person who leads a musical group; n. a substance that readily conducts e.g. electricity and heat; n. the person who collects fares on a public conveyance; n. a device designed to transmit electricity, heat, etc.
translation_zh: n. 领导者, 指挥者, 售票员, 向导；[化] 导体
example: 这个（乐队等的）指挥为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any cone-shaped artifact; n. a shape whose base is a circle and whose sides taper up to a point; n. cone-shaped mass of ovule- or spore-bearing scales or bracts; n. a visual receptor cell in the retina that is sensitive to bright light and to color
translation_zh: n. 圆锥体, 球果；vt. 使成锥形
example: 这个圆锥体为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: conferencing
translation_zh: [计] 召开会议
example: 这个会议为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. confess to a punishable or reprehensible deed, usually under pressure; v. confess to God in the presence of a priest, as in the Catholic faith
translation_zh: v. 承认, 坦白, 忏悔, 供认
example: 我们需要逐步confess这个方案。

meaning: n. an admission of misdeeds or faults; n. a written document acknowledging an offense and signed by the guilty party; n. (Roman Catholic Church) the act of a penitent disclosing his sinfulness before a priest in the sacrament of penance in the hope of absolution; n. a public declaration of your faith
translation_zh: n. 承认, 坦白, 招供；[法] 自白, 招供, 自认有罪
example: 这个承认为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. with confidence; in a confident manner
translation_zh: adv. 自信地；安心地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. prevent from leaving or from being removed; v. deprive of freedom; take into confinement
translation_zh: vt. 限制, 使不外出, 禁闭；vi. 邻接, 交界；n. 边缘, 范围, 区域
example: The patient was confined to bed.

meaning: v. oppose, as in hostility or a competition; v. deal with (something unpleasant) head on; v. present somebody with something, usually to accuse or criticize; v. be face to face with
translation_zh: vt. 使面对, 对抗, 遭遇, 使对质, 比较；[法] 对证, 使对质, 比较
example: She decided to confront her fears.

meaning: n. an uninflected function word that serves to conjoin words or phrases or clauses or sentences; n. the grammatical relation between linguistic units (words or phrases or clauses) that are connected by a conjunction; n. (astronomy) apparent meeting or passing of two or more celestial bodies in the same degree of the zodiac
translation_zh: n. 连接词, 联合, 结合；[计] 合取
example: The word 'and' is a common conjunction in English.

meaning: n. the act of conquering; n. success in mastering something difficult
translation_zh: n. 战胜, 征服, 战利品；[法] 征服, 赢得, 获得
example: The Norman Conquest of England occurred in 1066.

meaning: n. motivation deriving logically from ethical or moral principles that govern a person's thoughts and actions; n. conformity to one's own sense of right conduct; n. a feeling of shame when you do something immoral
translation_zh: n. 良心；[法] 良心, 道德感, 正义感
example: His conscience bothered him after he lied.

meaning: n. an alert cognitive state in which you are aware of yourself and your situation
translation_zh: n. 意识, 知觉, 自觉；[医] (有)意识, 清醒
example: 这个知觉意识为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. agreement in the judgment or opinion reached by a group as a whole
translation_zh: n. 合意, 一致, 同感；[计] 合意
example: After a long discussion, they reached a consensus.

meaning: n. permission to do something
translation_zh: n. 同意, 许可；vi. 同意, 赞同
example: You need parental consent to participate.

meaning: r to a great extent or degree
translation_zh: adv. 非常地, 很, 颇
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v deem to be; v give careful consideration to; v take into consideration for exemplifying purposes; v show consideration for; take into account; v think about carefully; weigh; v judge or regard; look upon; judge; v look at attentively; v look at carefully; study mentally; v regard or treat with consideration, respect, and esteem
translation_zh: prep. 就...而论；conj. 考虑到
example: 这个考虑到为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. (sometimes followed by `with') in agreement or consistent or reliable; s. the same throughout in structure or composition
translation_zh: a. 一致的, 坚持的, 并立的, 坚固的
example: Her performance has been consistent all season.

meaning: n. the comfort you feel when consoled in times of disappointment; n. the act of consoling; giving relief in affliction
translation_zh: n. 安慰, 令人安慰的事物；[法] 安慰, 慰问
example: She found consolation in her friends' support.

meaning: n. a scientific instrument consisting of displays and an input device that an operator can use to monitor and control a system (especially a computer system); n. an ornamental scroll-shaped bracket (especially one used to support a wall fixture)
translation_zh: vt. 安慰, 藉慰；n. 控制台；[计] 控制台
example: She tried to console her friend after the bad news.

meaning: n. a quantity that does not vary; n. a number representing a quantity assumed to have a fixed value in a specified mathematical context; a. steadfast in purpose or devotion or affection
translation_zh: n. 常数, 恒量；a. 不变的, 一定的, 时常的；[计] 常量; 常数; 恒值
example: The constant noise was annoying.

meaning: v. get or ask advice from; v. seek information from; v. advise professionally
translation_zh: vi. 商讨, 商量, 协商, 会诊；vt. 向...请教, 查阅, 考虑
example: 我们需要逐步consult这个方案。

meaning: n an expert who gives advice
translation_zh: n. 顾问, 征询意见者；[医] 顾问医师
example: She works as a business consultant.

meaning: v. make radioactive by adding radioactive material
translation_zh: vt. 弄污, 弄脏, 污染, 毒害；[化] 污染
example: The spilled chemicals could contaminate the water supply.

meaning: n. a person of nearly the same age as another; s. characteristic of the present; s. belonging to the present time
translation_zh: n. 同时代的人；a. 同时代的, 属于同一时期的
example: She is a leading figure in contemporary art.

meaning: n. lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike; n. a manner that is generally disrespectful and contemptuous; n. open disrespect for a person or thing; n. a willful disobedience to or disrespect for the authority of a court or legislative body
translation_zh: n. 轻视, 轻蔑；[法] 藐视, 侮辱, 轻视
example: 这个轻视为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a binding agreement between two or more persons that is enforceable by law; n. (contract bridge) the highest bid becomes the contract setting the number of tricks that the bidder must make; n. a variety of bridge in which the bidder receives points toward game only for the number of tricks he bid; v. enter into a contractual arrangement
translation_zh: n. 合约, 婚约, 契约；vt. 使皱缩, 使缩短, 感染, 订约, 缔结；vi. 皱缩, 订约, 收缩
example: They signed a new contract last week.

meaning: v. be in contradiction with; v. deny the truth of
translation_zh: vt. 反驳, 与...抵触, 与...矛盾；vi. 反驳
example: His actions contradict his words.

meaning: n. opposition between two conflicting forces or ideas; n. (logic) a statement that is necessarily false; n. the speech act of contradicting someone
translation_zh: n. 反驳, 矛盾；[法] 矛盾, 否认, 反驳
example: There was a clear contradiction between his two statements.

meaning: n. two propositions are contradictories if both cannot be true (or both cannot be false) at the same time; s. of words or propositions so related that both cannot be true and both cannot be false; s. unable to be both true at the same time
translation_zh: a. 反驳的, 反对的, 抗辩的；n. 矛盾因素, 对立物
example: His statements were contradictory, making it hard to believe him.

meaning: n. a contentious speech act; a dispute where there is strong disagreement
translation_zh: n. 论争, 辩论, 论战, 争论；[法] 论战, 争论, 争吵
example: The new policy sparked a lot of controversy among the public.

meaning: r in a convenient manner
translation_zh: a. 方便, 合宜
example: 他方便地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a large formal assembly; n. something regarded as a normative example; n. (diplomacy) an international agreement; n. the act of convening
translation_zh: n. 大会, 协定, 惯例, 约定；[计] 约定
example: It's a social convention to shake hands when you meet someone new.

meaning: a. following accepted customs and proprieties; s. conforming with accepted standards; a. (weapons) using energy for propulsion or destruction that is not nuclear energy; a. unimaginative and conformist
translation_zh: a. 传统的, 习惯的, 约定的；[经] 惯例的, 常规的, 传统的
example: She prefers conventional methods of teaching.

meaning: n. a proposition obtained by conversion; v. carry on a conversation; s. of words so related that one reverses the relation denoted by the other; s. turned about in order or relation
translation_zh: n. 相反的事物, 倒, 逆向；a. 相反的, 逆向的, 颠倒的；vi. 交谈, 谈话
example: 这个相反的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. with the terms of the relation reversed
translation_zh: adv. 相反, 逆, 颠倒, 反题, 反
example: Some people enjoy hot weather; conversely, others prefer cold.

meaning: n. an event that results in a transformation; n. a change in the units or form of an expression: "conversion from Fahrenheit to Centigrade"; n. a successful free throw or try for point after a touchdown; n. a spiritual enlightenment causing a person to lead a new life
translation_zh: n. 转变, 转换, 改变宗教信仰, 换位法；[计] 转换
example: The conversion of the old factory into apartments took a year.

meaning: n. a person who has been converted to another religious or political belief; v. change from one system to another or to a new plan or policy; v. change the nature, purpose, or function of something; v. change religious beliefs, or adopt a religious belief
translation_zh: n. 皈依者, 改变宗教信仰者；vt. 使改变信仰, 转换, 兑换, 倒置；vi. 皈依；[计] 转换
example: They plan to convert the old factory into apartments.

meaning: s. persuaded of; very sure; a. having a strong belief or conviction
translation_zh: a. 确信的, 深信的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常确信的的解释。

meaning: v work together on a common enterprise of project
translation_zh: vi. 合作, 协力, 配合；[化] 合作
example: 我们需要逐步cooperate这个方案。

meaning: n. joint operation or action; n. the practice of cooperating
translation_zh: n. 合作, 协力, 配合；[化] 合作
example: 这个合作为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a jointly owned commercial enterprise (usually organized by farmers or consumers) that produces and distributes goods and services and is run for the benefit of its owners; n. an association formed and operated for the benefit of those using it; a. done with or working with others for a common purpose or benefit
translation_zh: a. 合作的；合作社的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常合作的的解释。

meaning: n. a long cloak; worn by a priest or bishop on ceremonial occasions; v. come to terms with
translation_zh: vi. 竞争, 应付；n. 长袍
example: 我们需要逐步cope这个方案。

meaning: n. a ductile malleable reddish-brown corrosion-resistant diamagnetic metallic element; occurs in various minerals but is the only metal that occurs abundantly in large masses; used as an electrical and thermal conductor; n. a copper penny; n. a reddish-brown color resembling the color of polished copper; n. any of various small butterflies of the family Lycaenidae having coppery wings
translation_zh: n. 铜, 警察；[化] 铜Cu
example: 这个铜为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a variable color averaging a deep pink; n. the hard stony skeleton of a Mediterranean coral that has a delicate red or pink color and is used for jewelry; n. unfertilized lobster roe; reddens in cooking; used as garnish or to color sauces; n. marine colonial polyp characterized by a calcareous skeleton; masses in a variety of shapes often forming reefs
translation_zh: n. 珊瑚, 珊瑚色；[化] 珊瑚
example: The Great Barrier Reef is made of coral.

meaning: n. a small group of indispensable persons or things; n. the center of an object; n. the central part of the Earth; n. a cylindrical sample of soil or rock obtained with a hollow drill
translation_zh: n. 核心, 果心, 要点；vt. 挖...的核；[计] 内核, 核心网
example: The core of the problem is a lack of communication.

meaning: n. a stone in the exterior of a large and important building; usually carved with a date and laid with appropriate ceremonies; n. a stone at the outer corner of two intersecting masonry walls
translation_zh: n. 奠基石, 基础
example: Honesty is the cornerstone of a good relationship.

meaning: n. a brass musical instrument with a brilliant tone; has a narrow tube and a flared bell and is played by means of valves
translation_zh: n. 圆锥形纸袋, 短号；[医] 小助听筒
example: 这个短号为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (botany) the trumpet-shaped or cup-shaped outgrowth of the corolla of a daffodil or narcissus flower; n. one or more circles of light seen around a luminous object; n. (anatomy) any structure that resembles a crown in shape
translation_zh: n. 冠, 冠状物, 副冠, 根颈, 头顶, 牙冠, 檐板, 日冕, 月华, 日华, 电晕, 光圈；[计] 电晕, 冠
example: During a total solar eclipse, the sun's corona becomes visible.

meaning: n. a noncommissioned officer in the Army or Air Force or Marines
translation_zh: n. 下士；a. 肉体的, 身体的, 个人的
example: Corporal Jones led the patrol.

meaning: a. of or belonging to a corporation; s. done by or characteristic of individuals acting together; s. organized and maintained as a legal corporation
translation_zh: a. 社团的, 合伙的, 公司的；[经] 团体的, 法人的, 社团的
example: He works in corporate law.

meaning: n. a business firm whose articles of incorporation have been approved in some state
translation_zh: n. 公司, 合作, 法人团体；[法] 法人团体, 社团, 法人
example: She works for a large multinational corporation.

meaning: n. conformity to fact or truth; n. the quality of conformity to social expectations
translation_zh: [计] 正确性；[经] 正确性
example: The teacher emphasized the importance of correctness in grammar.

meaning: v. exchange messages
translation_zh: vi. 符合, 通信, 相当；[法] 符合, 一致, 相当
example: The numbers on the list correspond to the items in the box.

meaning: n. communication by the exchange of letters
translation_zh: n. 相符, 通信, 信件；[医] 对应, 相对
example: We maintain regular correspondence with our overseas clients.

meaning: n. someone who communicates by means of letters; n. a journalist employed to provide news stories for newspapers or broadcast media
translation_zh: n. 通讯记者, 通信者；[经] 客户, 代理商行, 代理银行
example: The war correspondent reported live from the front lines.

meaning: s. accompanying; s. similar especially in position or purpose
translation_zh: a. 相当的, 一致的, 通信的；[计] 对应
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常相当的的解释。

meaning: n. an enclosed passageway; rooms usually open onto it
translation_zh: n. 走廊, 回廊, 人口密集地带
example: 这个走廊为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. corrupt morally or by intemperance or sensuality; v. alter from the original; a. lacking in integrity; s. containing errors or alterations
translation_zh: a. 腐败的, 贪污的, 讹误充斥的；vt. 使腐烂, 腐蚀, 使恶化；vi. 腐烂, 堕落
example: The corrupt official was arrested for bribery.

meaning: n. decay of matter (as by rot or oxidation); n. moral perversion; impairment of virtue and moral principles; n. destroying someone's (or some group's) honesty or loyalty; undermining moral integrity; n. inducement (as of a public official) by improper means (as bribery) to violate duty (as by commiting a felony)
translation_zh: n. 腐败, 堕落, 贪污；[计] 论误
example: The government is fighting corruption.

meaning: s. having a high price
translation_zh: a. 昂贵的, 奢华的, 费用大的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常昂贵的的解释。

meaning: n. the attire worn in a play or at a fancy dress ball; n. unusual or period attire not characteristic of or appropriate to the time and place; n. the prevalent fashion of dress (including accessories and hair style as well as garments); n. the attire characteristic of a country or a time or a social class
translation_zh: n. 装束, 服装
example: 这个（戏剧或电影的）戏装为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a small house with a single story
translation_zh: n. 小屋, 茅舍
example: 这个小屋为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a sudden noisy expulsion of air from the lungs that clears the air passages; a common symptom of upper respiratory infection or bronchitis or pneumonia or tuberculosis; v. exhale abruptly, as when one has a chest cold or congestion
translation_zh: n. 咳嗽；vi. 咳嗽；vt. 咳出
example: 这个咳嗽为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a man from your own country; n. a man who lives in the country and has country ways
translation_zh: n. 同胞, 乡下人, 国民
example: 这个乡下人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. occurring or extending throughout a country or nation
translation_zh: a. 全国范围的
example: There was a countrywide protest against the new policy.

meaning: n. a courteous or respectful or considerate act; n. a courteous or respectful or considerate remark; n. a courteous manner
translation_zh: n. 礼貌, 谦恭, 好意；[法] 优待, 礼貌, 恩惠
example: He showed great courtesy to his guests.

meaning: n. a person who shows fear or timidity; n. English dramatist and actor and composer noted for his witty and sophisticated comedies (1899-1973)
translation_zh: n. 懦弱的人, 胆小的人
example: 这个胆小鬼为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. lacking courage; ignobly timid and faint-hearted
translation_zh: a. 怯懦的, 懦弱的；胆小的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常怯懦的的解释。

meaning: n. decapod having eyes on short stalks and a broad flattened carapace with a small abdomen folded under the thorax and pincers; n. a quarrelsome grouch; n. the edible flesh of any of various crabs; n. a stroke of the oar that either misses the water or digs too deeply
translation_zh: n. 螃蟹, 偏航, 脾气乖戾的人, 沙果；vi. 捕蟹, 偏航, 发牢骚；vt. 使偏航, 抱怨, 破坏
example: 这个螃蟹为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a long narrow opening; n. a sudden sharp noise; n. a blemish resulting from a break without complete separation of the parts; n. a purified and potent form of cocaine that is smoked rather than snorted; highly addictive
translation_zh: n. 裂缝, 爆裂声；v. (使)爆裂, (使)裂开, (使)发出爆裂声；a. 第一流的；adv. 啪地一声
example: 这个& vi. (使…)开裂为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a professional whose work is consistently of high quality; n. a creator of great skill in the manual arts; n. a skilled worker who practices some trade or handicraft
translation_zh: n. 工匠, 技工, 手艺人
example: The table was made by a master craftsman.

meaning: n. a faint constellation in the southern hemisphere near Hydra and Corvus; n. a bowl-shaped depression formed by the impact of a meteorite or bomb
translation_zh: n. 火山口, 环行山, 弹坑；[化] 焊口; 火山石; 弧坑; 焰口
example: The meteor left a huge crater when it hit the ground.

meaning: n. a very slow movement; n. a swimming stroke; arms are moved alternately overhead accompanied by a flutter kick; n. a slow mode of locomotion on hands and knees or dragging the body; v. move slowly; in the case of people or animals with the body near the ground
translation_zh: n. 爬行, 匍匐而行, 养鱼池；v. 爬行
example: 我们需要逐步crawl这个方案。

meaning: n an angular or rounded shape made by folding; n a slight depression in the smoothness of a surface; n a Malayan dagger with a wavy blade; v make wrinkles or creases on a smooth surface; make a pressed, folded or wrinkled line in; v make wrinkled or creased; v scrape gently; v become wrinkled or crumpled or creased
translation_zh: n. 皱痕, 折痕；v. (使)起皱痕
example: 这个皱褶为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in a creative manner
translation_zh: adv. 创造性地；有创造力地
example: 他创造性地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. any member of the Creek Confederacy (especially the Muskogee) formerly living in Georgia and Alabama but now chiefly in Oklahoma
translation_zh: n. 小溪, 小河, 小湾
example: 这个<英>小湾为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. annoying and unpleasant; s. causing a sensation as of things crawling on your skin
translation_zh: a. 爬行的, 令人毛骨悚然的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常令人毛骨悚然的的解释。

meaning: n. someone who has committed a crime or has been legally convicted of a crime; s. guilty of crime or serious offense; s. involving or being or having the nature of a crime
translation_zh: n. 罪犯, 犯人, 刑事；a. 犯了罪的, 刑事的, 有罪的
example: The police arrested the criminal.

meaning: n. someone who is unable to walk normally because of an injury or disability to the legs or back; v. deprive of strength or efficiency; make useless or worthless; v. deprive of the use of a limb, especially a leg
translation_zh: n. 跛者, 残废；vt. 使跛, 使成残废, 削弱；a. 跛的, 残废的
example: 这个使跛为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in a critical manner
translation_zh: adv. 批评性地, 审慎地, 精密地
example: 他精密地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. disapproval expressed by pointing out faults or shortcomings; n. a serious examination and judgment of something; n. a written evaluation of a work of literature
translation_zh: n. 批评, 评论, 非难；[法] 批判, 批评, 评论
example: He received a lot of criticism for his performance.

meaning: n. large voracious aquatic reptile having a long snout with massive jaws and sharp teeth and a body covered with bony plates; of sluggish tropical waters
translation_zh: n. 鳄鱼
example: 这个鳄鱼为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in an ill-natured manner
translation_zh: adv. 横地, 相反地, 故意为难地
example: 他十字架地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. of extreme importance; vital to the resolution of a crisis; s. having crucial relevance
translation_zh: a. 决定性的, 重要的, 严厉的；[医] 十字形的; 决断的, 定局的
example: It is crucial that we act immediately.

meaning: r. excessively; r. with cruelty
translation_zh: adv. 残忍地, 残酷地, 极
example: 他残酷地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a cruel act; a deliberate infliction of pain and suffering; n. feelings of extreme heartlessness; n. the quality of being cruel and causing tension or annoyance
translation_zh: n. 残酷, 野蛮, 残酷行为；[法] 残酷, 残忍, 虐待
example: Animal cruelty is a serious offense.

meaning: n. a hexahedron with six equal squares as faces; n. the product of three equal terms; n. any of several tropical American woody plants of the genus Lonchocarpus whose roots are used locally as a fish poison and commercially as a source of rotenone; n. a block in the (approximate) shape of a cube

meaning: n. an outward semblance that misrepresents the true nature of something; n. any attire that modifies the appearance in order to conceal the wearer's identity; n. the act of concealing the identity of something by modifying its appearance; v. make unrecognizable
translation_zh: n. 假面目, 假装；vt. 假装, 隐瞒
example: He wore a clever disguise to the party.

meaning: n. the quality of being dishonest; n. lack of honesty; acts of lying or cheating or stealing
translation_zh: n. 不诚实；[法] 不诚实, 诈欺, 不正
example: His dishonesty led to his dismissal from the company.

meaning: n freeing from false belief or illusions; v free from enchantment
translation_zh: n. 觉醒, 幻灭；vt. 使醒悟, 使幻想破灭
example: 我们需要逐步disillusion这个方案。

meaning: v. bar from attention or consideration; v. cease to consider; put out of judicial consideration; v. stop associating with; v. end one's encounter with somebody by causing or permitting the person to leave
translation_zh: vt. 解散, 开除, 解职；vi. 解散；[计] 解散
example: 我们需要逐步dismiss这个方案。

meaning: n. a physical condition in which there is a disturbance of normal functioning; n. a disturbance of the peace or of public order; v. bring disorder to
translation_zh: n. 杂乱, 混乱；vt. 扰乱, 使失调
example: The room was in complete disorder after the party.

meaning: a. undisciplined and unruly; s. in utter disorder
translation_zh: a. 无秩序的, 乱的, 骚乱的；[法] 妨害治安的, 骚乱的, 无法无天的
example: The police were called to break up a disorderly crowd.

meaning: a. capable of being dispensed with or done without
translation_zh: a. 不是必要的, 可有可无的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不必要的的解释。

meaning: v. cause to move, usually with force or pressure; v. terminate the employment of; discharge from an office or position
translation_zh: vt. 移置, 替换, 转移
example: The new factory will displace many local workers.

meaning: n. the feeling of being displeased or annoyed or dissatisfied with someone or something
translation_zh: n. 不愉快, 生气, 不满
example: The manager expressed his displeasure with the team's performance.

meaning: n. the power to use something or someone; n. the act or means of getting rid of something; n. a kitchen appliance for disposing of garbage
translation_zh: n. 丢掉, 处理, 排列, 销毁, 布置；[医] 处理, 处置
example: Waste disposal is a major environmental concern.

meaning: n. your usual mood; n. a natural or acquired habit or characteristic tendency in a person or thing
translation_zh: n. 性情, 处置, 处理, 布置；[医] 素因, 性情
example: 这个性情为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a disagreement or argument about something important; n. coming into conflict with
translation_zh: n. 争论；v. 争论
example: They had a dispute over the property.

meaning: v. make unfit or unsuitable; v. declare unfit
translation_zh: vt. 使不适合, 取消...资格
example: The athlete was disqualified for using banned substances.

meaning: n. lack of attention and due care; n. willful lack of care and attention
translation_zh: n. 忽视, 漠视；vt. 忽视, 不顾
example: He showed a complete disregard for the rules.

meaning: v. throw into disorder
translation_zh: a. 分裂的, 中断的；vt. 使分裂, 使瓦解
example: The loud music began to disrupt the class.

meaning: n. the feeling of being displeased and discontent
translation_zh: n. 不满, 不平
example: There was widespread dissatisfaction with the new policy.

meaning: v fail to satisfy; s in a state of sulky dissatisfaction
translation_zh: a. 不满的, 显出不满的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常使不满（dissatisfy的过去式和过去分词） adj. 不满意的的解释。

meaning: s. characterized by departure from accepted beliefs or standards
translation_zh: a. 意见不同的, 持不同政见的；n. 意见不同的人, 持不同政见者
example: 这个持异议者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. (used of persons) standing above others in character or attainment or reputation; s. used of a person's appearance or behavior; befitting an eminent person
translation_zh: a. 卓著的, 著名的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常卓越的的解释。

meaning: n. a change for the worse; n. a change (usually undesired) in the waveform of an acoustic or analog electrical signal; the difference between two measurements of a signal (as between the input and output signal); n. the act of distorting something so it seems to mean something it was not intended to mean
translation_zh: n. 扭曲, 变形, 曲解；[计] 畸变; 失真
example: 这个扭曲为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

translation_zh: vt. 转移, 分心, 使发狂
example: 我们需要逐步distract这个方案。

translation_zh: n. 娱乐, 分心的事物, 分心；[医] 注意力分散, 内脱位, 牙弓过宽
example: The noise was a major distraction.

meaning: s. causing distress or worry or anxiety
translation_zh: a. 使痛苦的, 使烦恼的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常使人痛苦的的解释。

meaning: n. someone who markets merchandise; n. a company that markets merchandise; n. electrical device that distributes voltage to the spark plugs of a gasoline engine in the order of the firing sequence
translation_zh: n. 分发者, 分布者, 散布者, 分配者, 销售者, 分配器, 配电盘, 自动拆版机；[计] 分配器
example: We are looking for a new distributor for our products in Asia.

meaning: n. an activity that diverts or amuses or stimulates; n. a turning aside (of your course or attention or concern); n. an attack calculated to draw enemy defense away from the point of the principal attack
translation_zh: n. 转移；[医] 转向
example: The road closure caused a major diversion.

meaning: v. send on a course or in a direction different from the planned or intended one; v. withdraw (money) and move into a different location, often secretly and with dishonest intentions
translation_zh: vt. 转移, 使欢娱；vi. 转移
example: The police had to divert traffic.

meaning: a. separated into parts or pieces; s. having a median strip or island between lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions; s. distributed in portions (often equal) on the basis of a plan or purpose
translation_zh: a. 分开的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常分离的的解释。

meaning: n. an army unit large enough to sustain combat; n. the act or process of dividing; n. an administrative unit in government or business; n. discord that splits a group
translation_zh: n. 分, 分开, 除法, 部门(如部、处、系等), 师；[计] 部分
example: The division of tasks made the project easier.

example: DNA carries genetic information in all living organisms.

meaning: n. an enclosure in a court of law where the defendant sits during the trial; n. any of certain coarse weedy plants with long taproots, sometimes used as table greens or in folk medicine; n. a platform where trucks or trains can be loaded or unloaded; n. landing in a harbor next to a pier where ships are loaded and unloaded or repaired; may have gates to let water in or out
translation_zh: n. 码头, 船坞, 被告席, 尾巴的骨肉部分；vt. 使靠码头, 使(船)进港, 剪短；vi. 进港
example: 这个码头为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a servant who is paid to perform menial tasks around the household; a. of concern to or concerning the internal affairs of a nation; a. of or relating to the home; a. of or involving the home or family
translation_zh: a. 家庭的, 国内的, 驯养的；[医] 家庭的, 家用的
example: We need to address domestic issues first.

meaning: v. be in control; v. have dominance or the power to defeat over; v. look down on
translation_zh: v. 支配, 占优势
example: The team managed to dominate the game from start to finish.

meaning: v. give to a charity or good cause
translation_zh: v. 捐赠
example: 我们需要逐步donate这个方案。

meaning: n a voluntary gift (as of money or service or ideas) made to some worthwhile cause; n act of giving in common with others for a common purpose especially to a charity
translation_zh: n. 捐赠物, 捐款, 捐赠；[经] 赠品, 捐款, 捐赠
example: 这个捐赠为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the symbol of the Democratic Party; introduced in cartoons by Thomas Nast in 1874

meaning: n. the entrance (the space in a wall) through which you enter or leave a room or building; the space that a door can close

example: 这个门口为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a college or university building containing living quarters for students
translation_zh: n. 宿舍
example: 这个宿舍为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a college or university building containing living quarters for students; n. a large sleeping room containing several beds
translation_zh: n. 宿舍
example: 这个集体宿舍为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a measured portion of medicine taken at any one time; n. the quantity of an active agent (substance or radiation) taken in or absorbed at any one time; v. treat with an agent; add (an agent) to
translation_zh: n. 剂量, 服用量；vt. 给药, (用药)医治；vi. 服药
example: 这个剂量为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. to double the degree; r. in a twofold manner
translation_zh: adv. 加倍地, 双重地；[计] 双地

meaning: s. open to doubt or suspicion; s. fraught with uncertainty or doubt; s. unsettled in mind or opinion
translation_zh: a. 可疑的, 疑心的, 不明确的；[法] 怀疑的, 有疑问的, 未确的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常难以预测的的解释。

meaning: n. any of numerous small pigeons; n. someone who prefers negotiations to armed conflict in the conduct of foreign relations; n. an emblem of peace

example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（坐、倒、躺）下的解释。

translation_zh: n. 衰败, 大雨

meaning: v. dismiss from work; v. make in a smaller size; v. reduce in size or number
translation_zh: vt. 以较小尺寸设计；缩小尺寸；裁减人数

translation_zh: n. 嫁妆；[法] 陪嫁物, 嫁妆

meaning: n. emptying something accomplished by allowing liquid to run out of it; n. tube inserted into a body cavity (as during surgery) to remove unwanted material; n. a pipe through which liquid is carried away; n. a gradual depletion of energy or resources
translation_zh: n. 排水沟, 消耗, 排水；vt. 排出, 喝光, 耗尽；vi. 排水, 流干

meaning: n. cloth gracefully draped and arranged in loose folds
translation_zh: n. 帏帐, 布料
example: The elegant drapery framed the large window.

meaning: n fearful expectation or anticipation; v be afraid or scared of; be frightened of; s causing fear or dread or terror
translation_zh: n. 恐惧, 可怕的人(或事)；a. 可怕的, 可怖的；v. 恐惧, 害怕
example: She felt a sense of dread as the deadline approached.

translation_zh: a. 可怕的

translation_zh: a. 空幻的, 梦想的

translation_zh: a. 可以喝的, 饮用的；n. 饮料

translation_zh: vi. 下垂, 消沉；vt. 使下垂；n. 低垂, 消沉

translation_zh: n. 退学学生, 中途退学；[电] 离去
example: He became a successful entrepreneur despite being a college dropout.

translation_zh: n. 干旱, 缺乏
example: The region is experiencing a severe drought.

meaning: n. a prearranged fight with deadly weapons by two people (accompanied by seconds) in order to settle a quarrel over a point of honor; n. any struggle between two skillful opponents (individuals or groups); v. fight a duel, as over one's honor or a woman
translation_zh: n. 决斗, 斗争；vi. 决斗
example: The two knights fought a duel.

meaning: n. a copy that corresponds to an original exactly; v. make or do or perform again; v. make a duplicate or duplicates of; s. identically copied from an original
translation_zh: n. 副本, 复本, 复制品；a. 复制的, 二重的；vt. 复制, 使加倍；[计] 复制
example: Make sure you don't create duplicate files on your computer.

meaning: n. the act of copying or making a duplicate (or duplicates) of something
translation_zh: n. 副本, 复制；[医] 重迭, 双折, 复制

translation_zh: n. 矮子, 侏儒；v. (使)变矮小

meaning: n. a usually soluble substance for staining or coloring e.g. fabrics or hair; v. color with dye
translation_zh: n. 颜料, 染料；vt. 染, 染色；vi. 被着色

translation_zh: a. 动态的, 有活力的, 有力的, 动力的, 不断变化的；n. 动力, 动态；[计] 动态的

meaning: r. with eagerness; in an eager manner
translation_zh: adv. 渴望, 热衷于, 热切
example: 他渴望地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. any of various large keen-sighted diurnal birds of prey noted for their broad wings and strong soaring flight; n. (golf) a score of two strokes under par on a hole; n. a former gold coin in the United States worth 10 dollars; n. an emblem representing power
translation_zh: n. 鹰, 鹰状标饰
example: 这个鹰为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n the excess of revenues over outlays in a given period of time (including depreciation and other non-cash expenses); n something that remunerates; v earn on some commercial or business transaction; earn as salary or wages; v acquire or deserve by one's efforts or actions
translation_zh: n. 所赚的钱, 工资, 收入；[经] 工资, 收入, 收益, 盈余
example: 这个收入为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. freedom from difficulty or hardship or effort; n. a freedom from financial difficulty that promotes a comfortable state; n. freedom from constraint or embarrassment; v. move gently or carefully
translation_zh: n. 安乐, 安逸, 悠闲；vt. 使安乐, 使安心, 减轻, 放松；vi. 减轻, 放松, 灵活地移动
example: 这个减轻为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. toward the east
translation_zh: n. 朝东方向；a. 向东方的；adv. 向东

meaning: r. with respect to ecology; economically, it is a disaster"
translation_zh: adv. 从生态学的观点看
example: 他从生态学的观点看地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a biologist who studies the relation between organisms and their environment
translation_zh: n. 生态学者
example: An ecologist presented findings on climate change.

meaning: s. avoiding waste
translation_zh: a. 节俭的, 经济的, 合算的；[经] 经济的, 节约的
example: Buying in bulk can be more economical in the long run.

meaning: n. an expert in the science of economics
translation_zh: n. 经济学者, 经济家；[经] 经济学家
example: The economist predicted a rise in inflation next year.

meaning: s. feeling great rapture or delight
translation_zh: n. 狂喜的人；a. 狂喜的

meaning: v. prepare for publication or presentation by correcting, revising, or adapting; v. supervise the publication of; v. cut and assemble the components of; v. cut or eliminate
translation_zh: vt. 编辑, 编校, 修订, 剪辑；[计] 编辑; DOS外部命令:该命令是一个用于编辑文本文件的全屏幕编辑程序
example: 这个编辑为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. of or relating to an article stating opinions or giving perspectives; a. relating to or characteristic of an editor
translation_zh: n. 社论, 评论；a. 编辑的, 主笔的, 社论的

meaning: a. possessing an education (especially having more than average knowledge); s. characterized by full comprehension of the problem involved
translation_zh: a. 受过教育的, 有教养的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常有教育的的解释。

meaning: n. someone who educates young people
translation_zh: n. 教育家
example: 这个（尤指作为一种职业的）教育工作者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in actuality or reality or fact
translation_zh: adv. 有效地, 有力地, 实际上
example: The new system effectively reduced costs.

meaning: n. power to be effective; the quality of being able to bring about an effect
translation_zh: n. 效力；[经] 有效性, 能行性
example: The effectiveness of the new policy is still being evaluated.

meaning: a. subject to popular election; s. not compulsory
translation_zh: a. 选举的, 根据选举的, 选修的；n. 选修课程
example: Students can choose two elective courses this semester.

meaning: n. a person who installs or repairs electrical or telephone lines
translation_zh: n. 电学家, 电气技师, 电工；[化] 电工; 电气工人

meaning: r. by electronic means
translation_zh: adv. 电子地

meaning: n. the branch of physics that deals with the emission and effects of electrons and with the use of electronic devices
translation_zh: n. 电子学；[计] 电子学
example: 这个电子学为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a refined quality of gracefulness and good taste; n. a quality of neatness and ingenious simplicity in the solution of a problem (especially in science or mathematics)
translation_zh: n. 高雅, 典雅, 优雅

meaning: a. refined and tasteful in appearance or behavior or style; s. suggesting taste, ease, and wealth; s. displaying effortless beauty and simplicity in movement or execution
translation_zh: a. 优雅的, 端庄的, 高雅的

meaning: r. with elegance; in a tastefully elegant manner; r. in a gracefully elegant manner
translation_zh: adv. 优美地
example: 他优美地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. relating to or being an element; a. relating to severe atmospheric conditions
translation_zh: a. 元素的, 基本的

meaning: a. qualified for or allowed or worthy of being chosen

translation_zh: n. 精华, 精锐, 中坚分子

meaning: n. powerful and effective language
translation_zh: n. 口才, 雄辩术, 雄辩；[法] 善辩, 口才

meaning: s. expressing yourself readily, clearly, effectively
translation_zh: a. 雄辩的, 有口才的, 有说服力的

translation_zh: n. 大使馆, 大使馆全体人员；[经] 大使馆
example: We visited the American embassy in London.

meaning: n. the act of clasping another person in the arms (as in greeting or affection); n. the state of taking in or encircling; n. a close affectionate and protective acceptance; v. include in scope; include as part of something broader; have as one's sphere or territory
translation_zh: n. 拥抱；vt. 拥抱, 互相拥抱, 包含, 收买；vi. 拥抱

translation_zh: n. 出现, 浮现, 发生

meaning: r without question and beyond doubt
translation_zh: adv. 强调地, 着重地
example: She emphatically denied the accusations.

meaning: n the state of being employed or having a job; v put into service; make work or employ for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose; v engage or hire for work
translation_zh: n. 雇用；vt. 雇用, 使用, 使从事于
example: 我们需要逐步employ这个方案。

meaning: n. a person or firm that employs workers
translation_zh: n. 雇主, 老板；[经] 雇主, 业主
example: 这个雇主为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. with unflagging resolve; r. (spatial sense) without bounds
translation_zh: adv. 不断地, 无穷尽地
example: 他无穷地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. sign as evidence of legal transfer
translation_zh: vt. 支持, 赞同, 背书于, 签署；[经] 赞成, 背书
example: 我们需要逐步endorse这个方案。

meaning: n. the power to withstand hardship or stress
translation_zh: n. 忍耐, 忍耐力, 耐性；[机] 持九性
example: Running a marathon requires great endurance.

meaning: s. patiently bearing continual wrongs or trouble
translation_zh: a. 持久的, 忍耐的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常持久的的解释。

meaning: v. ensure observance of laws and rules;; v. compel to behave in a certain way
translation_zh: vt. 强迫, 执行, 坚持；[经] 予以强制执行
example: The police are here to enforce the law.

meaning: n. employment for performers or performing groups that lasts for a limited period of time; n. contact by fitting together; n. the act of sharing in the activities of a group
translation_zh: n. 诺言, 约会, 婚约, 交战；[医] 衔接
example: Their engagement was announced last week.

meaning: v. flow over or cover completely
translation_zh: vt. 卷入, 吸进, 吞没, 使全神贯注
example: The flames quickly engulfed the old building.

meaning: v. increase; v. make better or more attractive
translation_zh: vt. 提高, 加强, 增加
example: This software can enhance the quality of your photos.

meaning: n. a purposeful or industrious undertaking (especially one that requires effort or boldness); n. an organization created for business ventures; n. readiness to embark on bold new ventures
translation_zh: n. 企业, 事业心, 进取心, 干事业；[计] 企业
