translation_zh: n. 标签, 附属物, 碎片, 结束语, 口头禅, 附加语, 浑名, 标记, 标记符；vt. 附以签条, 尾随, 添饰, 起浑名, 连接；vi. 紧紧跟随；[计] 标记
example: 这个标签为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the posterior part of the body of a vertebrate especially when elongated and extending beyond the trunk or main part of the body; n. any projection that resembles the tail of an animal; n. a spy employed to follow someone and report their movements; n. (usually plural) the reverse side of a coin that does not bear the representation of a person's head
translation_zh: n. 尾部, 后部, 辫子, 随员, 特务, 燕尾服, 踪迹, 限定继承(权)；a. 在后面的, 从后面而来的, 限定继承的, 尾部的, 后部的；vt. 为...装尾, 附于其后, 尾随, 使搭牢, 跟踪, 监视；vi. 跟踪, 船尾搁浅
example: 这个尾为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. correct by punishment or discipline; s. flat and uninspiring; a. very restrained or quiet; a. brought from wildness into a domesticated state
translation_zh: a. 驯服的, 柔顺的, 被开垦的, 顺从的, 乏味的, 平淡的；vt. 驯养, 驯服, 制服, 失去锋芒；vi. 变得驯服
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常驯服的的解释。

meaning: n. a browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun; n. a light brown the color of topaz; v. treat skins and hides with tannic acid so as to convert them into leather; v. get a tan, from wind or sun
translation_zh: n. 黄褐色, 鞣料, 马戏团；a. 黄褐色的, 鞣皮的；vi. 晒成棕褐色；vt. 把...晒黑, 鞣(革), 狠狠鞭打
example: 这个晒成棕褐色 adj. 黄褐色的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. converted to leather by a tanning agent
translation_zh: [医]鞣酸处理的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常医鞣酸处理的的解释。

meaning: n a small piece of cloth or paper
translation_zh: n. 破布条, 破衣服, 梭编工人；vt. 把...扯碎；vi. 变破烂
example: 这个tatter（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a drumbeat or bugle call that signals the military to return to their quarters; n. a design on the skin made by tattooing; n. the practice of making a design on the skin by pricking and staining; v. stain (skin) with indelible color
translation_zh: n. 归营号, 连续有节奏的敲击, 文身, 矮种马；vt. 连续有节奏地敲, 刺花纹于；vi. 作连续有节奏的敲击
example: She got a new tattoo on her arm.

meaning: n aggravation by deriding or mocking or criticizing; v harass with persistent criticism or carping
translation_zh: n. 辱骂, 嘲弄；vt. 嘲弄, 奚落；a. 很高的
example: The bullies would often taunt him about his new glasses.

meaning: n. as much as a teaspoon will hold; n. a small spoon used for stirring tea or coffee; holds about one fluid dram
translation_zh: n. 茶匙；[医] 茶匙(4毫升)
example: 这个茶匙为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a pickup truck with a gun mounted on it; a. of or relating to technique or proficiency in a practical skill; a. characterizing or showing skill in or specialized knowledge of applied arts and sciences; a. of or relating to a practical subject that is organized according to scientific principles
translation_zh: a. 技术上的, 专门的, 工业的, 严格根据法律的；[化] 技巧
example: He has a lot of technical knowledge about computers.

meaning: r. with regard to technique; r. with regard to technical skill and the technology available; r. according to the exact meaning; according to the facts
translation_zh: adv. 技术上, 学术上, 专门地
example: Technically, the rule applies to everyone.

meaning: n. a magnifier of images of distant objects; v. crush together or collapse; v. make smaller or shorter
translation_zh: n. 望远镜；vi. 叠缩, 嵌进, 缩短；vt. 使叠缩, 使缩短
example: 这个望远镜为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. (of weather or climate) free from extremes; mild; or characteristic of such weather or climate; a. not extreme in behavior
translation_zh: a. 温和的, 适度的, 有节制的, 温带的
example: The temperate climate of the region is ideal for agriculture.

meaning: r. for a limited time only; not permanently
translation_zh: adv. 暂时, 一时, 临时
example: 他暂时地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. something that seduces or has the quality to seduce; n. the desire to have or do something that you know you should avoid
translation_zh: n. 诱惑, 诱惑物；[法] 诱惑, 诱惑物
example: She resisted the temptation to eat the whole cake.

meaning: n. something that can be used as an official medium of payment; n. car attached to a locomotive to carry fuel and water; n. a boat for communication between ship and shore; n. ship that usually provides supplies to other ships
translation_zh: a. 嫩的, 柔软的, 脆弱的, 温柔的, 亲切的, 未成熟的, 微妙的, 棘手的, 审慎的；vt. 使变嫩, 提供, 偿还；vi. 变柔软, 投标；n. 照料, 看管人, 供应船, 小船, 提出, 偿付, 投标
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常温柔的的解释。

meaning: r. with tenderness; in a tender manner
translation_zh: adv. 温和地；体贴地；柔和地
example: 他温和地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a tendency to express warm and affectionate feeling; n. a pain that is felt (as when the area is touched); n. warm compassionate feelings
translation_zh: n. 柔软, 亲切, 柔和, 敏感, 易触痛；[医] 触痛
example: He showed great tenderness towards the injured animal.

meaning: n. a level shelf of land interrupting a declivity (with steep slopes above and below); n. a row of houses built in a similar style and having common dividing walls (or the street on which they face); v. provide (a house) with a terrace; v. make into terraces as for cultivation
translation_zh: n. 阶地, 梯田, 房屋之平顶, 阳台, 沿岸防地, 露台；a. 叠层式的；vt. 使成梯田, 使成有平台屋顶
example: 这个平台为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v fill with terror; frighten greatly; s causing extreme terror
translation_zh: a. 令人恐惧的；骇人的；极大的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常令人恐惧的的解释。

meaning: n. an area of knowledge or interest; n. the geographical area under the jurisdiction of a sovereign state
translation_zh: n. 领土, 领地, 版图, 地区, 活动范围；[经] (推销员等的)推销区域
example: 这个领土为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. give testimony in a court of law; v. provide evidence for
translation_zh: v. 证明, 作证, 声明, 表明
example: He was called to testify in court.

meaning: n. a solemn statement made under oath; n. an assertion offering firsthand authentication of a fact; n. something that serves as evidence
translation_zh: n. 证言, 证据, 声明；[医] 证据
example: 这个（尤指法庭上的）证词为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: pron., a., conj., &  As a demonstrative pronoun (pl. Those),; that usually points out, or refers to, a person or thing previously; mentioned, or supposed to be understood. That, as a demonstrative, may; precede the noun to which it refers; as, that which he has said is; true; those in the basket are good apples.; pron., a., conj., &  As an adjective, that has the same; demonstrative force as the pronoun, but is followed by a noun.; pron., a., conj., &  As a relative pronoun, that is; equivalent to who or which, serving to point out, and make definite, a; person or thing spoken of, or alluded to, before, and may be either; singular or plural.; pron., a., conj., &  As a conjunction, that retains much of; its force as a demonstrative pronoun.; pron., a., conj., &  To introduce a clause employed as the; object of the preceding verb, or as the subject or predicate nominative; of a verb.; pron., a., conj., &  To introduce, a reason or cause; --; equivalent to for that, in that, for the reason that, because.; pron., a., conj., &  To introduce a purpose; -- usually; followed by may, or might, and frequently preceded by so, in order, to; the end, etc.; pron., a., conj., &  To introduce a consequence, result, or; effect; -- usually preceded by so or such, sometimes by that.; pron., a., conj., &  In an elliptical sentence to introduce; a dependent sentence expressing a wish, or a cause of surprise,; indignation, or the like.; pron., a., conj., &  As adverb: To such a degree; so; as, he; was that frightened he could say nothing.
translation_zh: a. 那, 那个；conj. 以致, 因为；pron. 那；adv. 那么, 那样
example: 他那个地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a unifying idea that is a recurrent element in literary or artistic work; n. (music) melodic subject of a musical composition; v. provide with a particular theme or motive
translation_zh: n. 主题, 话题, 题目
example: 这个乐主题为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone who theorizes (especially in science or art)
translation_zh: n. 理论家, 理论工作者
example: She is a leading theorist in the field of quantum physics.

meaning: n. a person skilled in a particular type of therapy
translation_zh: n. 治疗学家；[医] 治疗学家
example: 这个治疗专家为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (medicine) the act of caring for someone (as by medication or remedial training etc.)
translation_zh: n. 治疗；[医] 疗法, 治疗
example: She is undergoing physical therapy for her knee injury.

meaning: r. from that time on
translation_zh: adv. 其后, 从那时以后
example: 他此后地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. measuring instrument for measuring temperature
translation_zh: n. 温度计, 体温计；[化] 温度计
example: 这个温度计为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an unproved statement put forward as a premise in an argument
translation_zh: n. 论题, 论文
example: She is writing her master's thesis.

meaning: r. spoken with poor articulation as if with a thick tongue; r. with a thick consistency; r. with thickness; in a thick manner
translation_zh: adv. 厚地；浓地
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the dimension through an object as opposed to its length or width; n. indistinct articulation; n. used of a line or mark; n. resistance to flow
translation_zh: n. 厚度, 密度, 愚钝, 含混不清；[医] 厚度
example: 这个厚(度)为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the part of the leg between the hip and the knee
translation_zh: n. 大腿, 股；[医] 股, 大腿
example: 这个股为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an important intellectual; n. someone who exercises the mind (usually in an effort to reach a decision)
translation_zh: n. 思想者, 思想家
example: She is a deep thinker, always questioning things.

meaning: r in the third place
translation_zh: adv. 第三
example: 他第三三分之一地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a physiological need to drink; v. feel the need to drink
translation_zh: n. 口渴, 渴望；vi. 口渴, 渴望
example: 这个（口）渴为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in an exhaustive manner; r. completely and absolutely (`good' is sometimes used informally for `thoroughly')
translation_zh: adv. 彻底地, 绝对地, 透彻地, 详尽地, 周到地, 完全地, 完善地, 全面地
example: Please clean the room thoroughly.

meaning: r. (postpositive) however
translation_zh: adv. 然而, 可是；conj. 虽然, 纵然
example: 他虽然地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. having intellectual depth; a. exhibiting or characterized by careful thought; s. acting with or showing thought and good sense; s. considerate of the feelings or well-being of others
translation_zh: a. 深思的, 体贴的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常沉思的的解释。

meaning: a. showing lack of careful thought; s. without care or thought for others; `Let them eat cake'"
translation_zh: a. 欠考虑的, 无深虑的, 轻率的
example: It was thoughtless of him to forget her birthday.

meaning: n. a fine cord of twisted fibers (of cotton or silk or wool or nylon etc.) used in sewing and weaving; v. pass a thread through; v. remove facial hair by tying a fine string around it and pulling at the string; v. pass through or into
translation_zh: n. 线, 丝, 纤维, 线索；vt. 穿线于, 穿过, 通过, 用线穿成；vi. 穿过；[计] 线索, 线程
example: 这个线为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. to utter intentions of injury or punishment against:"He threatened me when I tried to call the police"; v. to be a menacing indication of something:"The clouds threaten rain"
translation_zh: vt. 恐吓, 威胁, 预示...的凶兆；vi. 威胁, 恫吓, 可能来临
example: The dark clouds threaten rain.

meaning: n. something that causes you to experience a sudden intense feeling or sensation; v. cause to be thrilled by some perceptual input; v. feel sudden intense sensation or emotion
translation_zh: n. 震颤, 激动, 刺激性, 一阵激动；vi. 震颤, 颤抖, 激动；vt. 使激动, 使颤动
example: The roller coaster ride thrilled the children.

meaning: s. feeling intense pleasurable excitement
translation_zh: a. 非常兴奋的; 极为激动的；vt. “thrill”的过去式和过去分词
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常非常兴奋的的解释。

meaning: s. causing quivering or shivering as by cold or fear or electric shock
translation_zh: a. 毛骨悚然的, 令人兴奋的, 令人发抖的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常令人兴奋的的解释。

meaning: n. the passage to the stomach and lungs; in the front part of the neck below the chin and above the collarbone; n. an opening in the vamp of a shoe at the instep; n. a passage resembling a throat in shape or function;; n. the part of an animal's body that corresponds to a person's throat
translation_zh: n. 咽喉, 喉咙, 嗓音；vt. 用喉音说, 开沟于
example: 这个喉咙为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a cutaneous sensation often resulting from light stroking; n. the act of tickling; v. touch (a body part) lightly so as to excite the surface nerves and cause uneasiness, laughter, or spasmodic movements; v. touch or stroke lightly
translation_zh: n. 胳肢, 痒；vt. 胳肢, 使发痒, 使快乐, 逗乐；vi. 觉得痒, 使人痒
example: 我们需要逐步tickle这个方案。

meaning: n. tightly stretched rope or wire on which acrobats perform high above the ground
translation_zh: n. 拉紧的绳索
example: The acrobat walked across the tightrope with incredible balance.

meaning: s unaffected by time
translation_zh: a. 无时间限制的, 不受时间影响的, 永恒的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常永恒的的解释。

meaning: n being at the right time; n timely convenience
translation_zh: [经] 时间性, 及时性
example: 这个timeliness（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a more or less definite period of time now or previously present
translation_zh: n. 时代, 境遇, 时报
example: 这个乘以 v. 乘为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the time when something happens; n. the regulation of occurrence, pace, or coordination to achieve a desired effect (as in music, theater, athletics, mechanics)
translation_zh: n. 时间选择, 时间测定, 定时, 调速；[计] 定时器时钟
example: The timing of the announcement was perfect.

meaning: n. the tip of a toe; v. walk on one's toes; s. walking on the tips of ones's toes so as to make no noise; r. on tiptoe or as if on tiptoe
translation_zh: n. 脚尖；vi. 用脚尖走；adv. 踮着脚；a. 踮着脚走的, 偷偷摸摸的
example: 我们需要逐步tiptoe这个方案。

meaning: n temporary loss of strength and energy resulting from hard physical or mental work
translation_zh: n. 疲劳, 疲倦；[医] 疲惫, 疲倦
example: 这个tiredness（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s so lacking in interest as to cause mental weariness
translation_zh: a. 累人的, 烦人的
example: The long meeting was quite tiresome.

meaning: n. the nail at the end of a toe
translation_zh: n. 脚趾甲, 斜钉；[医] 趾甲
example: 这个脚趾甲为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n productive work (especially physical work done for wages); v work hard
translation_zh: n. 辛苦, 苦工, 网, 罗网, 圈套；vi. 苦干, 跋涉
example: 我们需要逐步toil这个方案。

meaning: a. showing respect for the rights or opinions or practices of others; s. able to tolerate environmental conditions or physiological stress; s. showing the capacity for endurance
translation_zh: a. 宽容的, 容忍的, (对冷、热)能耐的；[医] 能耐受的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常宽容的的解释。

meaning: v. recognize and respect (rights and beliefs of others); v. have a tolerance for a poison or strong drug or pathogen or environmental condition
translation_zh: vt. 宽容, 容许, 有耐力
example: I cannot tolerate such rude behavior.

meaning: n. a fee levied for the use of roads or bridges (used for maintenance); v. ring slowly; v. charge a fee for using
translation_zh: n. 通行费, 代价, 钟声；vt. 征收, 敲钟, 鸣钟, 勾引, 引诱；vi. 征税, 鸣钟
example: The accident took a heavy toll.

meaning: n a place for the burial of a corpse (especially beneath the ground and marked by a tombstone)
translation_zh: n. 坟墓, 死亡；vt. 埋葬
example: The ancient king was buried in a grand tomb.

meaning: n a United States unit of weight equivalent to 2000 pounds; n a British unit of weight equivalent to 2240 pounds
translation_zh: n. 吨；[经] 吨
example: 这个吨为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a light usually carried in the hand; consists of some flammable substance; v. burn maliciously, as by arson
translation_zh: n. 火把, 启发之物；[化] 火炬
example: 这个火把为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the mottled horny substance of the shell of some turtles; n. brilliantly colored; larvae feed on nettles; n. a cat having black and cream-colored and yellowish markings
translation_zh: n. 龟甲, 玳瑁壳, 龟板, 玳瑁色
example: 这个tortoiseshell（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. unbearable physical pain; n. the deliberate, systematic, or wanton infliction of physical or mental suffering by one or more persons in an attempt to force another person to yield information or to make a confession or for any other reason; v. subject to torture
translation_zh: n. 拷问, 苦闷；vt. 拷问, 曲解, 折磨, 使弯曲
example: 我们需要逐步torture这个方案。

meaning: a. not given to gentleness or sentimentality; a. physically toughened; a. resistant to cutting or chewing
translation_zh: n. 恶棍；a. 强硬的, 艰苦的, 坚固的, 坚韧的, 粗暴的, 咬不动的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（物质的解释。

meaning: a. of or relating to or caused by a toxin or poison
translation_zh: a. 有毒的, 中毒的；[医] 中毒的, 毒物的
example: Be careful, that plant is toxic.

meaning: n. someone who purchases and maintains an inventory of goods to be sold
translation_zh: n. 商人, 商船；[经] 交易者, 商船
example: The stock trader made a significant profit today.

meaning: n. a large transport conveyance designed to be pulled by a truck or tractor; n. a wheeled vehicle that can be pulled by a car or truck and is equipped for occupancy
translation_zh: n. 追踪者, 拖车；[电] 拖车
example: 这个预告片为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. someone who is being trained
translation_zh: n. 实习生, 新兵, 受培训者；[经] 学徒工, 培训人员
example: 这个练习生为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. one who trains other persons or animals
translation_zh: n. 训练员, 驯马师；[电] 列车器
example: 这个助理教练为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a distinguishing feature of your personal nature
translation_zh: n. 特征, 特性, 一笔, 少许
example: Honesty is a valuable trait.

meaning: n. someone who betrays his country by committing treason
translation_zh: n. 叛逆者, 叛国者；[法] 叛徒, 叛逆, 背信者
example: He was accused of being a traitor to his country.

meaning: n. a disreputable vagrant; n. a heavy footfall; v. travel on foot, especially on a walking expedition; v. cross on foot
translation_zh: n. 坚实(或沉重)的脚步声, 流浪者；vi. 践踏, 重步行走, 步行, 流浪；vt. 走过, 踩
example: We heard the tramp of heavy boots approaching.

meaning: n. the sound of heavy treading or stomping; v. injure by trampling or as if by trampling
translation_zh: n. 践踏(声), 蹂躏；v. 践踏, 无视
example: The crowd began to trample the flowers in the park.

meaning: n. something that has been transcribed; a written record (usually typewritten) of dictated or recorded speech; n. a reproduction of a written record (e.g. of a legal or school record)
translation_zh: n. 抄本, 副本, 成绩单；[法] 法院文本, 官方记录, 记录的副本
example: I need a transcript of my academic records.

meaning: n. someone who transfers or is transferred from one position to another; n. the act of transfering something from one form to another; n. a ticket that allows a passenger to change conveyances; n. application of a skill learned in one situation to a different but similar situation
translation_zh: n. 迁移, 移动, 传递, 转让, 转移, 过户, 汇兑, 换车；vt. 使转移, 调转, 调任, 改变, 传递, 转让；vi. 转移, 转学, 转职, 换车；[计] 传送
example: 这个转移为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the introduction of blood or blood plasma into a vein or artery; n. the action of pouring a liquid from one vessel to another
translation_zh: n. 倾注, 输血, 输液；[医] 输血, 输液
example: The patient needed a blood transfusion.

meaning: n. one who stays for only a short time; n. (physics) a short-lived oscillation in a system caused by a sudden change of voltage or current or load
translation_zh: n. 瞬, 短期居留者, 过境鸟, 瞬变现象；a. 短暂的, 易变的, 瞬变的, 路过的；[计] 瞬变过程; 过渡过程; 过渡的; 瞬变的; 瞬时峰值电压
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常转瞬即逝的的解释。

meaning: n. a semiconductor device capable of amplification
translation_zh: n. 晶体管；[化] 晶体管
example: Transistors are fundamental components in modern electronics.

meaning: n. a change from one place or state or subject or stage to another; n. a musical passage moving from one key to another; n. a passage that connects a topic to one that follows; v. cause to convert or undergo a transition
translation_zh: n. 转变, 转换, 变迁, 过渡时期, 临时转调；[化] 跃迁
example: The transition from school to university can be challenging.

meaning: a. designating a verb that requires a direct object to complete the meaning
translation_zh: a. 及物的；n. 及物动词
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常及物的的解释。

meaning: n. a written communication in a second language having the same meaning as the written communication in a first language; n. a uniform movement without rotation; n. (mathematics) a transformation in which the origin of the coordinate system is moved to another position but the direction of each axis remains the same; n. (genetics) the process whereby genetic information coded in messenger RNA directs the formation of a specific protein at a ribosome in the cytoplasm
translation_zh: n. 翻译, 译文, 转化, 调任, 平移, 转译；[计] 转换
example: 这个翻译译本为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person who translates written messages from one language to another; n. a program that translates one programming language into another
translation_zh: n. 翻译者；[计] 翻译程序; 翻译器
example: 这个译员为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of sending a message; causing a message to be transmitted; n. communication by means of transmitted signals; n. the gears that transmit power from an automobile engine via the driveshaft to the live axle
translation_zh: n. 传输, 传送, 变速器；[计] 传输
example: The transmission of the disease was rapid.

meaning: v. send from one person or place to another
translation_zh: vt. 传输, 传染, 传达, 遗传, 发射, 传播；vi. 发射信号, 留传下来；[计] 传送
example: The radio tower transmits signals across the region.

meaning: s. easily understood or seen through (because of a lack of subtlety)
translation_zh: a. 透明的, 显然的, 清晰的；[计] 透明
example: The glass was completely transparent.

meaning: v. travel across or pass over; v. deny formally (an allegation of fact by the opposing party) in a legal suit
translation_zh: n. 越过, 横贯, 横断物, 屏障, 否认, 反驳；vt. 横过, 穿过, 经过, 详细研究, 反对, 在...来回移动；vi. 横越, 横断, 旋转, 来回移动；a. 横亘的, 横贯的
example: 这个横穿为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an open receptacle for holding or displaying or serving articles or food
translation_zh: n. 托盘, 公文盘, 满盘, 发射箱；[化] 淋盘
example: 这个托盘为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the grooved surface of a pneumatic tire; n. the part (as of a wheel or shoe) that makes contact with the ground; n. structural member consisting of the horizontal part of a stair or step; v. tread or stomp heavily or roughly
translation_zh: n. 踏, 步态, 梯级, 交尾, 鞋底；vi. 踏, 行走, 交尾；vt. 踩, 踏, 践踏, 跳(舞)
example: The car's tires had very little tread left.

meaning: n. a written agreement between two states or sovereigns
translation_zh: n. 条约, 谈判；[经] 协议, 协定, 协商
example: The two countries signed a peace treaty.

meaning: n. a journey by ox wagon (especially an organized migration by a group of settlers); n. any long and difficult trip; v. journey on foot, especially in the mountains; v. make a long and difficult journey
translation_zh: vi. 牛拉货车, 艰苦跋涉；n. 牛车旅行, 艰苦跋涉
example: They decided to trek across the mountains.

meaning: r extremely
translation_zh: adv. 极大地; 极端地; 极其; 非常
example: 他极大地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. an involuntary vibration (as if from illness or fear); n. a small earthquake; n. shaking or trembling (usually resulting from weakness or stress or disease); v. shake with seismic vibrations
translation_zh: n. 震动, 颤动；[医] 震颤
example: The slight tremor of the ground indicated a minor earthquake.

meaning: n. trying something to find out about it; n. (law) the determination of a person's innocence or guilt by due process of law; n. (sports) a preliminary competition to determine qualifications; n. an annoying or frustrating or catastrophic event
translation_zh: n. 审判, 试验, 艰苦, 麻烦事, 考验；a. 审讯的, 试验性的
example: The suspect is currently awaiting trial.

meaning: n. a three-sided polygon; n. something approximating the shape of a triangle; n. any of various triangular drafting instruments used to draw straight lines at specified angles; n. a percussion instrument consisting of a metal bar bent in the shape of an open triangle
translation_zh: n. 三角形, 三个一组, 三角关系；[医] 三角, 三角形
example: 这个三角形为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a social division of (usually preliterate) people; n. a federation (as of American Indians); n. (biology) a taxonomic category between a genus and a subfamily
translation_zh: n. 宗族, 部落, 一群人；[医] 族(生物分类)
example: 这个部落为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s not to be trusted; s having concealed difficulty; s marked by skill in deception
translation_zh: a. 狡猾的, 机敏的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常狡猾的的解释。

meaning: n. a musical composition for three performers; n. three performers or singers who perform together; n. a set of three similar things considered as a unit; n. three people considered as a unit
translation_zh: n. 三重唱
example: 这个三人一组为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. concerned with trivialities
translation_zh: a. 琐碎的, 不重要的, 轻微的, 平常的
example: Don't worry about such trivial matters.

meaning: n a wheeled vehicle that runs on rails and is propelled by electricity
translation_zh: n. 电车, 手推车, 台车；vt. 用手推车运；vi. 乘电车
example: 这个手推车为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a group of soldiers; n. a cavalry unit corresponding to an infantry company; n. a unit of Girl or Boy Scouts; n. an orderly crowd
translation_zh: n. 军队, 一群, 一队；vi. 群集, 结队, 成群而行
example: The troops were deployed to the affected area.

meaning: n. an award for success in war or hunting; n. something given as a token of victory
translation_zh: n. 战利品, 奖品；vt. 用战利品装饰
example: 这个奖品为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. either of two parallels of latitude about 23.5 degrees to the north and south of the equator representing the points farthest north and south at which the sun can shine directly overhead and constituting the boundaries of the Torrid Zone or tropics
translation_zh: n. 回归线
example: The climate in the tropics is generally hot and humid.

meaning: s. difficult to deal with
translation_zh: a. 麻烦的, 令人讨厌的
example: The troublesome child refused to go to bed.

meaning: n. the main stem of a tree; usually covered with bark; the bole is usually the part that is commercially useful for lumber; n. luggage consisting of a large strong case used when traveling or for storage
translation_zh: n. 树干, 干线, 躯干, 主干, 象鼻, 箱子；vt. 把...放入旅行箱内；a. 树干的, 躯干的, 干线的, 箱形的；[计] 中继线; 母线
example: 这个树干为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. something (as property) held by one party (the trustee) for the benefit of another (the beneficiary); n. the trait of believing in the honesty and reliability of others; n. a consortium of independent organizations formed to limit competition by controlling the production and distribution of a product or service; v. have confidence or faith in
translation_zh: n. 信任, 信赖, 相信, 受托, 职责, 信心, 托拉斯；a. 信托的, 托拉斯的；vt. 信赖, 信任, 相信, 盼望, 赊卖给；vi. 相信, 信赖, 依靠；[计] 委托, 信任
example: 这个相信为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a convict who is considered trustworthy and granted special privileges
translation_zh: a. 可信任的, 可信赖的, 可靠的；n. 可信任的人, 模范犯人
example: He always relied on his trusty old car.

meaning: a. expressing or given to expressing the truth; s. conforming to truth
translation_zh: a. 说真话的, 诚实的, 真实的, 如实的；[法] 真实的, 说实话的, 诚实的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常说实话的的解释。

meaning: n. the quality of being truthful
translation_zh: n. 真实；正当；坦率
example: The judge questioned the truthfulness of the witness's statement.

meaning: n. a large open vessel for holding or storing liquids; n. the amount that a tub will hold
translation_zh: n. 桶, 浴盆；vt. 装入桶, 洗澡；vi. 洗盆浴, 被放在桶里洗
example: 这个浴盆为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. infection transmitted by inhalation or ingestion of tubercle bacilli and manifested in fever and small lesions (usually in the lungs but in various other parts of the body in acute stages)
translation_zh: n. 肺结核；[医] 顿挫性结核
example: 这个肺结核为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a sudden abrupt pull; v. pull hard; v. strive and make an effort to reach a goal; v. tow (a vessel) with a tug
translation_zh: n. 用力拉, 拖曳, 苦干, 挣扎, 绳索；v. 用力拉
example: 这个（用力地）拉为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a fee paid for instruction (especially for higher education)
translation_zh: n. 学费, 讲授
example: 这个学费 (n.) - 教育费用为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any of numerous perennial bulbous herbs having linear or broadly lanceolate leaves and usually a single showy flower
translation_zh: n. 郁金香
example: 这个郁金香为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a passageway through or under something, usually underground (especially one for trains or cars); v. force a way through
translation_zh: n. 隧道, 地下道；vi. 挖隧道；vt. 掘隧道于
example: 这个隧道为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s characterized by unrest or disorder or insubordination; s (of a liquid) agitated vigorously; in a state of turbulence
translation_zh: a. 狂暴的, 骚乱的, 紊乱的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常骚乱的的解释。

meaning: v. be a tutor to someone; give individual instruction; v. act as a guardian to someone
translation_zh: n. 家庭教师, 导师, 助教, 监护人；vt. 当...的教师, 教, 指导, 约束, 克制；vi. 当家庭教师, 受家庭教师的指导
example: 这个导师为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a rapid change in brightness; a brief spark or flash; v. emit or reflect light in a flickering manner
translation_zh: n. 闪烁, 闪耀, 瞬息；vi. 闪烁；vt. 使闪耀
example: 这个闪烁为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v to move in a twisting or contorted motion, (especially when struggling); v cause (a plastic object) to assume a crooked or angular form; v turn in the opposite direction; v form into a spiral shape; v form into twists; v extend in curves and turns; v do the twist; v twist or pull violently or suddenly, especially so as to remove (something) from that to which it is attached or from where it originates; v practice sophistry; change the meaning of or be vague about in order to mislead or deceive; v twist suddenly so as to sprain; s having an intended meaning altered or misrepresented
translation_zh: a. 扭曲的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常（感情、欲望等）反常的的解释。

meaning: n. serious infection marked by intestinal inflammation and ulceration; caused by Salmonella typhosa ingested with food or water
translation_zh: a. 伤寒的；n. 伤寒
example: He was diagnosed with typhoid fever.

meaning: n a form of government in which the ruler is an absolute dictator (not restricted by a constitution or laws or opposition etc.); n dominance through threat of punishment and violence
translation_zh: n. 专制, 暴政；[法] 苛政, 暴政, 专横
example: 这个暴政为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a cruel and oppressive dictator; n. in ancient Greece, a ruler who had seized power without legal right to it; n. any person who exercises power in a cruel way
translation_zh: n. 暴君；[法] 专制君主, 暴君, 压制他人者
example: 这个专制统治者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the finest or most superior quality of its kind; a. furthest or highest in degree or order; utmost or extreme; s. being the last or concluding element of a series
translation_zh: n. 终极, 根本, 顶点, 基本原则；a. 终极的, 根本的, 极限的, 最远的, 最后的, 最大的
example: Our ultimate goal is to achieve peace.

meaning: r. as the end result of a succession or process
translation_zh: adv. 最后, 最终；[法] 最后, 终究, 总之
example: Ultimately, the decision is yours.

meaning: s. not adequate to give satisfaction; a. not acceptable; not welcome; s. not conforming to standard usage; `You can access your cash at any of 300 automatic tellers'"
translation_zh: a. 无法接受的, 不受欢迎的；[法] 不能接受的, 不受欢迎的, 难以承认的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不能接受的的解释。

meaning: r. without shame
translation_zh: adv. 厚颜无耻
example: 他无耻的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. lacking beauty or charm; s. lacking power to arouse interest; s. not appealing to the senses
translation_zh: a. 无吸引力的, 无魅力的, 乏味的, 不美的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不吸引人的的解释。

meaning: a. not available or accessible or at hand
translation_zh: a. 得不到的, 不能利用的, 无用的；[化] 不可得的; 无效的; 不能利用的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常难以获得的的解释。

meaning: a. (often followed by `of') not aware
translation_zh: a. 未认识到的, 不知道的；[法] 不知道的, 不察觉的, 无意的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不知道的的解释。

meaning: a incapable of being put up with
translation_zh: a. 无法忍受的, 承受不住的
example: The heat was almost unbearable.

meaning: s. hard to defeat
translation_zh: a. 无敌的, 无与伦比的
example: The team proved to be unbeatable this season.

meaning: a. not made or become different
translation_zh: a. 无变化的；[经] 持稳的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常未改变的的解释。

meaning: a. distinctive and not typical
translation_zh: a. 无典型特征的；不典型的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不典型的的解释。

meaning: unclearly
translation_zh: [网络] 含糊地；不清晰
example: 他不清楚的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: r. in physical discomfort
translation_zh: adv. 不舒适地, 不自在地, 令人不快地
example: 他不舒适地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. not common or ordinarily encountered; unusually great in amount or remarkable in character or kind
translation_zh: a. 不寻常的, 非凡的, 罕有的；adv. 不平常地
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不寻常的的解释。

meaning: a. lacking in interest or care or feeling; s. easy in mind; not worried; s. not occupied or engaged with
translation_zh: a. 漠不关心的；[法] 无关的, 不相关的, 不关心的
example: She seemed completely unconcerned by the news.

meaning: a. not conscious; lacking awareness and the capacity for sensory perception as if asleep or dead; s. without conscious volition; s. (followed by `of') not knowing or perceiving
translation_zh: a. 未意识到的, 无意识的, 无知觉的；[医] 人事不省的, 神志丧失的; 无意识的
example: He was knocked unconscious after the fall.

meaning: n. an estimation that is too low; an estimate that is less than the true or actual value; v. make too low an estimate of
translation_zh: n. 低估；vt. 低估, 看轻
example: Don't underestimate the power of a good book.

meaning: n. a university student who has not yet received a first degree
translation_zh: n. 大学本科生, 大学肄业生；a. 大学生的
example: She is an undergraduate student studying history.

meaning: n. a secret group organized to overthrow a government or occupation force; r. in or into hiding or secret operation; r. beneath the surface of the earth
translation_zh: n. 地下, 地铁, 地道, 秘密活动；a. 地下的, 秘密的；adv. 在地下, 秘密地
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常地下的地下组织的的解释。

meaning: r. on the lower or downward side; on the underside of; r. under or below an object or a surface; at a lower place or level; directly beneath
translation_zh: adv. 在下面；prep. 在...的下面
example: 他较低的地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s beneath the surface of the sea
translation_zh: a. 海面下的；adv. 在海面下
example: They explored the undersea world with scuba gear.

meaning: s capable of being apprehended or understood
translation_zh: a. 可以理解的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常能懂的的解释。

meaning: n. the cognitive condition of someone who understands; s. characterized by understanding based on comprehension and discernment and empathy
translation_zh: n. 理解, 谅解；[法] 协商, 协议, 谅解
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常理解的解释。

meaning: v. enter upon an activity or enterprise; v. accept as a challenge; v. promise to do or accomplish; v. accept as a charge
translation_zh: vt. 试图, 从事, 保证, 承担, 同意, 接受；[化] 承包; 承担
example: The company decided to undertake a new project.

meaning: n. undergarment worn next to the skin and under the outer garments
translation_zh: n. 内衣
example: 这个衬衣为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. without doubt; certainly
translation_zh: adv. 无疑, 必定, 确实地
example: She is undoubtedly the best candidate for the job.

meaning: s. not imagined even in a dream
translation_zh: a. 梦想不到的, 意外的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常undreamed（adjective）的解释。

meaning: s. of lumber or stone or hides; not finished or dressed
translation_zh: a. 不穿衣服的, 便服的, 没加调味品的, 未梳理的, 未修剪的, 未加工的, 粗糙的；[化] 未经处理的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常脱…衣服的解释。

meaning: n physical discomfort (as mild sickness or depression); n the trait of seeming ill at ease
translation_zh: n. 不安
example: There was a general sense of unease in the room after the announcement.

meaning: r with anxiety or apprehension
translation_zh: adv. 不自在地；不稳定地；心神不安地
example: 他心神不安地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. not enthusiastic; lacking excitement or ardor
translation_zh: a. 不热心的, 缺乏热情的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不…的解释。

meaning: a. not even or uniform as e.g. in shape or texture; s. variable and recurring at irregular intervals
translation_zh: a. 不平坦的, 不均等的, 奇数的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不平坦的的解释。

meaning: a. not known or well known
translation_zh: a. 不熟悉的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不熟悉的的解释。

meaning: a. not in accord with or not following current fashion
translation_zh: a. 不流行的, 不时髦的, 过时的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常过时的的解释。

meaning: s not anticipated
translation_zh: a. 未预料的
example: The project faced unforeseen challenges that delayed its completion.

meaning: s characterized by iniquity; wicked because it is believed to be a sin
translation_zh: a. 不敬畏神的, 不可思议的, 邪恶的；adv. 可怕地, 令人憎厌地
example: We had to wake up at an ungodly hour to catch the flight.

meaning: n. state characterized by emotions ranging from mild discontentment to deep grief
translation_zh: n. 苦恼；忧愁
example: 这个不快为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. providing no assistance
translation_zh: a. 不起帮助作用的, 无用的, 无益的, 不予帮助的, 不予合作的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不…的解释。

meaning: s totally unlikely
translation_zh: a. 不能想象的, 不可思议的
example: The scale of the disaster was unimaginable.

meaning: r. to an unimaginable extent
translation_zh: adv. 不能想像地；难以理解地
example: 他unimaginably（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: a. characterized by unity; being or joined into a single entity
translation_zh: a. 联合的, 团结的, 一致的, 和睦的；[法] 联合的, 统一的, 一致的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常统一的的解释。

meaning: n. (linguistics) a grammatical rule (or other linguistic feature) that is found in all languages; n. (logic) a proposition that asserts something of all members of a class; n. a behavioral convention or pattern characteristic of all members of a particular culture or of all human beings; s. applicable to or common to all members of a group or set
translation_zh: a. 全世界的, 普遍的, 宇宙的, 通用的；n. 一般概念
example: Love is a universal emotion.

meaning: r. in an unjust manner
translation_zh: adv. 不义地, 不法地
example: He was unjustly accused of the crime.

meaning: a. lacking kindness
translation_zh: a. 不仁慈的, 不亲切的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不仁慈的的解释。

meaning: a. having no limits in range or scope
translation_zh: a. 无限的, 不受限制的, 无条件的；[经] 无限的, 不定的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常无限的的解释。

meaning: v. take the load off (a container or vehicle)
translation_zh: vi. 卸货；vt. 从...卸下, 摆脱...之负担, 倾销, 卸(货)；[计] 卸载
example: 我们需要逐步unload这个方案。

meaning: v. open the lock of; v. set free or release; v. become unlocked
translation_zh: vt. 开...的锁, 开启, 表露, 放出；vi. 被开启, 揭开, 解放；[计] 解出锁定
example: 我们需要逐步unlock这个方案。

meaning: s. clearly evident to the mind
translation_zh: a. 不会弄错的, 不会被误解的, 不会搞错的, 明白无误的, 清楚明白的
example: The smell of freshly baked bread was unmistakable.

meaning: r. without possibility of mistake
translation_zh: adv. 显而易见地; 不会弄错地; 不会误解地; 明白地
example: The voice on the phone was unmistakably his.

meaning: a. not in accordance with or determined by nature; contrary to nature
translation_zh: a. 不自然的, 反常的, 不近人情的；[法] 不自然的, 违背人道, 邪恶的
example: The silence in the forest felt unnatural.

meaning: a. not having official authority or sanction; s. not officially established
translation_zh: a. 非正式的, 非官方的；[化] 非法定的; 未入药典的
example: This is an unofficial translation of the document.

meaning: a. regarded with disfavor or lacking general approval
translation_zh: a. 不得人心的, 不受欢迎的, 不流行的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不受欢迎的的解释。

meaning: a. not realistic
translation_zh: a. 不切实际的, 幻想的
example: His expectations were completely unrealistic.

meaning: a. not reasonable; not showing good judgment
translation_zh: a. 不合理的, 过度的, 不切实际的；[法] 不讲道理的, 非理智的, 不合理的
example: His demands were completely unreasonable.

meaning: a. not worthy of reliance or trust; s. lacking a sense of responsibility
translation_zh: a. 不可靠的；[法] 不可靠的, 靠不住的
example: The old car proved to be very unreliable.

meaning: n. a feeling of restless agitation
translation_zh: n. 不安的状态, 动荡的局面；[医] 不安
example: The country was experiencing political unrest.

meaning: a lacking in security or safety; a involving or causing danger or risk; liable to hurt or harm; s not safe from attack
translation_zh: a. 不安全的, 不安稳的, 危险的；[经] 不安全
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不安全的的解释。

meaning: a. not giving satisfaction
translation_zh: a. 不令人满意的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不能令人满意的的解释。

meaning: a. disregarding your own advantages and welfare over those of others; s. not greedy
translation_zh: a. 不自私的, 无我的, 不谋私利的
example: Her unselfish act of kindness touched everyone.

meaning: a. not capable of being stopped
translation_zh: a. 无法停止的, 不可阻碍的
example: The team was unstoppable, winning every game.

meaning: a. not successful; having failed or having an unfavorable outcome
translation_zh: a. 不成功的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不成功的的解释。

meaning: s. not meant or adapted for a particular purpose; s. not conducive to good moral development
translation_zh: a. 不适合的；[法] 不适合的, 不适当的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不合适的的解释。

meaning: a lacking self-confidence; a lacking or indicating lack of confidence or assurance
translation_zh: a. 不肯定的, 不确定的, 没有自信的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不确定的的解释。

meaning: a. devoid of talent; not gifted
translation_zh: a. 缺乏才能的, 没有才干的；没有天赋的；不聪明的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不…的解释。

meaning: r to an unimaginable extent
translation_zh: adv. unthinkable的变形
example: 他unthinkably（adverb）地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: v. undo the ties of; v. cause to become loose
translation_zh: vt. 解开；vi. 松开
example: 我们需要逐步untie这个方案。

meaning: prep. To; -- now used only in antiquated, formal, or scriptural; style. See To.; prep. Until; till.; conj. Until; till.
translation_zh: prep. 到, 对, 直到
example: 这个对为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. not given medical care or treatment; a. not subjected to chemical or physical treatment; s. (of a specimen for study under a microscope) not treated with a reagent or dye
translation_zh: [化] 未经处理的
example: The untreated water was not safe to drink.

meaning: a. not trimmed
translation_zh: 未装饰的, 未修饰的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常untrimmed（adjective）的解释。

meaning: n. uncommonness by virtue of being unusual
translation_zh: 不寻常性；奇异性
example: 这个unusualness（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. not disposed or inclined toward; s. in spite of contrary volition
translation_zh: a. 不愿意的, 勉强的；[法] 不愿意的, 勉强的, 不服从的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不愿意的的解释。

meaning: s. showing or resulting from lack of judgment or wisdom
translation_zh: a. 愚蠢的, 欠考虑的, 不明智的, 轻率的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不明智的的解释。

meaning: a. not concerned with the temporal world or swayed by mundane considerations
translation_zh: a. 非现世的, 非尘世的, 超自然的, 精神上的, 超凡的, 出世的, 天真的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常非尘世的的解释。

meaning: n. properties acquired during a person's formative years
translation_zh: n. 教养
example: Her strict upbringing made her very disciplined.

meaning: n. news that updates your information; v. modernize or bring up to date; v. bring up to date; supply with recent information; v. bring to the latest state of technology
translation_zh: vt. 更新, 使现代化；n. 更新；[计] 更新
example: 这个更新为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. software that provides better performance than an earlier version did; n. a reservation that is improved; n. the property possessed by a slope or surface that rises; n. hardware that provides better performance than an earlier version did
translation_zh: n. 上坡, 升级, 上升；adv. 往上；vt. 使升级, 提升, 改良品种；vi. 升级；[计] 升级
example: We need an upgrade to our computer system.

meaning: n. a vertical structural member as a post or stake; n. a piano with a vertical sounding board; s. in a vertical position; not sloping
translation_zh: a. 正直的, 诚实的, 公正的, 垂直的, 竖式的；[化] 立杆
example: Please keep the box upright.

meaning: a. relating to or concerned with a city or densely populated area; a. located in or characteristic of a city or city life
translation_zh: a. 都市的, 住在都市的, 习惯于都市的；[法] 城市的, 都市的, 市区的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常城市的的解释。

meaning: r. with great urgency
translation_zh: adv. 急切地；迫切地；紧急地
example: 他紧急地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a person who makes use of a thing; someone who uses or employs something
translation_zh: n. 使用者；[计] 用户
example: 这个用户 n. 使用者 n. (User)人名为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an official stationed at the entrance of a courtroom or legislative chamber; n. someone employed to conduct others; v. take (someone) to their seats, as in theaters or auditoriums
translation_zh: n. 引座员, 招待员；vt. 引导, 招待；vi. 作招待员
example: 我们需要逐步usher这个方案。

meaning: n. a company that performs a public service; subject to government regulation; n. the quality of being of practical use; n. the service (electric power or water or transportation) provided by a public utility; n. (economics) a measure that is to be maximized in any situation involving choice
translation_zh: n. 功用, 有用之物, 实用, 公用事业, 实用程序；a. 实用的, 有多种用途的；[计] 实用程序, 工具
example: The new software has great utility for data analysis.

meaning: v. express audibly; utter sounds (not necessarily words); v. put into circulation
translation_zh: a. 全然的, 绝对的, 完全的；vt. 发出声音, 做声, 发表, 发射, 流通
example: The meeting was an utter disaster.

meaning: r completely and without qualification; used informally as intensifiers
translation_zh: adv. 完全地, 全然, 绝对
example: 他全然地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. void of thought or knowledge; s. without an occupant or incumbent
translation_zh: a. 空的, 空白的, 空虚的, 空闲的, 茫然的, 空缺的；[法] 空的, 空虚的, 闲暇的
example: The house has been vacant for months.

meaning: n. immunogen consisting of a suspension of weakened or dead pathogenic cells injected in order to stimulate the production of antibodies
translation_zh: n. 牛痘苗, 疫苗；a. 疫苗的, 牛痘的
example: Scientists are working on a new vaccine for the virus.

meaning: n. a sweetheart chosen to receive a greeting on Saint Valentine's Day; n. a card sent or given (as to a sweetheart) on Saint Valentine's Day
translation_zh: n. 情人, 情人节礼物
example: 这个情人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. well grounded in logic or truth or having legal force; s. still legally acceptable
translation_zh: a. 有确实根据的, 有法律效力的, 正当的, 正确的；[经] 有效的
example: Your passport is valid for another six months.

meaning: v. become invisible or unnoticeable; v. cease to exist; v. decrease rapidly and disappear
translation_zh: vi. 消失, 不见, 成为零
example: 我们需要逐步vanish这个方案。

meaning: n. the quality of being valueless or futile
translation_zh: n. 虚荣心, 虚无, 自负, 空虚, 时髦的小摆饰
example: 这个虚荣（心）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an instance of change; the rate or magnitude of change; n. an activity that varies from a norm or standard; n. a repetition of a musical theme in which it is modified or embellished; n. an artifact that deviates from a norm or standard
translation_zh: n. 变更, 变化, 变种, 变奏；[医] 变异, 变易; 变度
example: 这个变化为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. characterized by variety; s. widely different; s. broken away from sameness or identity or duplication
translation_zh: a. 不同的, 杂色的, 各式各样的；[法] 不同的, 种种的, 变化的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常多变的的解释。

meaning: n. any venturesome undertaking especially one with an uncertain outcome; n. a commercial undertaking that risks a loss but promises a profit; v. proceed somewhere despite the risk of possible dangers; v. put at risk
translation_zh: n. 冒险, 风险；vt. 敢于, 冒...的危险；vi. 冒险
example: 这个敢于为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the scene of any event or action (especially the place of a meeting); n. in law: the jurisdiction where a trial will be held
translation_zh: n. 犯罪地点, 审判地, 发生地点
example: The concert venue was packed with fans.

meaning: s. communicated in the form of words; a. of or relating to or formed from words in general; a. of or relating to or formed from a verb; a. relating to or having facility in the use of words
translation_zh: a. 用言辞的, 言语的, 口头的, 逐字的, 动词的；[医] 言语的, 口述的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常词语的的解释。

meaning: r. as a verb; r. by means of language
translation_zh: adv. 口头地, 非书面地
example: 他言词上地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a piece of poetry; n. a line of metrical text; v. compose verses or put into verse; v. familiarize through thorough study or experience
translation_zh: n. 诗, 韵文, 诗句；vt. 用诗表达；vi. 作诗
example: 这个诗为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an interpretation of a matter from a particular viewpoint; n. something a little different from others of the same type; n. manual turning of a fetus in the uterus (usually to aid delivery)
translation_zh: n. 一种描述, 版本, 译文；[计] 版本
example: 这个（同一种物件稍有不同的）样式为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: prep. Against; as, John Doe versus Richard Roe; -- chiefly; used in legal language, and abbreviated to v. or vs.
translation_zh: prep. 对...；[法] 诉, 对, 相形
example: 这个（表示两队或双方对阵）对为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. precisely as stated; r. used as intensifiers; `real' is sometimes used informally for `really'; `rattling' is informal; r. precisely so
translation_zh: a. 真正的, 恰好的, 十足的, 特有的；adv. 非常, 完全
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常十足的的解释。

meaning: n. a serviceman who has seen considerable active service; n. a person who has served in the armed forces; n. an experienced person who has been through many battles; someone who has given long service
translation_zh: n. 老手, 退伍军人, 老兵, 老树；a. 老兵的, 老练的, 经验丰富的
example: He is a veteran of the music industry.

meaning: v. shake, quiver, or throb; move back and forth rapidly, usually in an uncontrolled manner
translation_zh: vi. 振动, 颤动, 激动, 摇摆, 踌躇；vt. 使颤动, 使振动, 使摆动
example: 我们需要逐步vibrate这个方案。

meaning: n. the act of vibrating; n. a distinctive emotional aura experienced instinctively
translation_zh: n. 振动, 颤动；[化] 振动
example: 这个震动为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an optical device for viewing photographic transparencies
translation_zh: n. 观察者, 看电视者, 视察员, 观察器；[化] 指示器
example: 这个电视观众为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. characterized by forceful and energetic action or activity; s. strong and active physically or mentally
translation_zh: a. 精力充沛的, 元气旺盛的, 茁壮的, 有力的
example: He took a vigorous walk every morning.

meaning: r. with vigor; in a vigorous manner
translation_zh: adv. 朝气蓬勃, 精力充沛, 壮健, 茁壮, 健壮, 强有力
example: 他精神旺盛地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. Mexican revolutionary leader (1877-1923); n. detached or semidetached suburban house; n. country house in ancient Rome consisting of residential quarters and farm buildings around a courtyard; n. pretentious and luxurious country residence with extensive grounds
translation_zh: n. 别墅
example: 这个别墅为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. one who has lived in a village most of their life
translation_zh: n. 村民
example: 这个在乡村住的人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. sour-tasting liquid produced usually by oxidation of the alcohol in wine or cider and used as a condiment or food preservative; n. dilute acetic acid
translation_zh: n. 醋, 尖酸刻薄；vt. 加醋于
example: 这个醋为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. fail to agree with; be in violation of; as of rules or patterns; v. destroy
translation_zh: vt. 违犯, 亵渎, 违反, 侵犯, 妨碍；[经] 违犯, 违反
example: He was accused of violating the law.

meaning: r. in essence or effect but not in fact
translation_zh: adv. 事实上
example: The city was virtually empty during the holiday.

meaning: n. the quality of doing what is right and avoiding what is wrong; n. morality with respect to sexual relations; n. a particular moral excellence
translation_zh: n. 德行, 美德, 优点, 功效, 效力；[法] 美德, 贞操, 优点
example: 这个高尚的道德为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r. in a visible manner; r. so as to be visible
translation_zh: adv. 看得见地, 明显地, 明白地
example: 他明显地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. performing an essential function in the living body; s. manifesting or characteristic of life
translation_zh: a. 生命的, 重要的, 充满活力的, 生死攸关的, 致命的；[医] 生命的, 生活的, 生活上必需的, 紧要的
example: It is vital to stay hydrated.

meaning: n. any of a group of organic substances essential in small quantities to normal metabolism
translation_zh: n. 维生素；[化] 维生素
example: 这个维生素为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a person who sings
translation_zh: n. 声乐家, 歌手
example: 这个声乐家为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (military) a person who freely enlists for service; n. a person who performs voluntary work; v. tell voluntarily; v. agree freely
translation_zh: n. 志愿者；a. 志愿的；v. 自愿
example: 这个志愿者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the matter ejected in vomiting; n. the reflex act of ejecting the contents of the stomach through the mouth; v. eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth
translation_zh: vt. 吐出, 呕吐；vi. 呕吐；n. 呕吐, 呕吐物, 催吐剂
example: 这个呕吐为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a citizen who has a legal right to vote
translation_zh: n. 选民, 投票人；[法] 选民, 选举人, 投票人
example: 这个选举人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a solemn pledge (to oneself or to another or to a deity) to do something or to behave in a certain manner; v. make a vow; promise; v. dedicate to a deity by a vow
translation_zh: n. 誓约, 誓言, 许愿；vi. 起誓, 发誓, 郑重宣言；vt. 立誓, 起誓要, 郑重地宣布
example: They exchanged wedding vows at the ceremony.

meaning: n. something that remunerates
translation_zh: n. 工资, 报应, 报偿；vt. 开展, 进行；vi. 进行
example: 这个进行为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the narrowing of the body between the ribs and hips
translation_zh: n. 腰部, 腰；[医] 腰
example: 这个腰为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n a man's sleeveless garment worn underneath a coat
translation_zh: n. 西装背心, 马甲
example: He wore a smart three-piece suit with a waistcoat.

meaning: n. the act of waiting (remaining inactive in one place while expecting something); v. stay in one place and anticipate or expect something; v. wait before acting; v. serve as a waiter or waitress in a restaurant
translation_zh: n. 等待, 等候；vt. 等候, 期待, 延缓, 伺候, 推迟；vi. 等, 等候, 耽搁, 伺候用餐；[计] 等待
example: 这个等待为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a walking trip or tour; n. a public stroll by a celebrity to meet people informally; n. nomadic excursions into the bush made by an Aborigine
translation_zh: n. 徒步旅行
example: 这个walkabout（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. New Zealand runner who in 1975 became the first person to run a mile in less that 3 minutes and 50 seconds (born in 1952); n. United States writer (born in 1944); n. a shoe designed for comfortable walking; n. a light enclosing framework (trade name Zimmer) with rubber castors or wheels and handles; helps invalids or the handicapped or the aged to walk
translation_zh: n. 徒步者, 轻便鞋；[法] 山林巡视官
example: 这个步行者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a wide flat board used to cover walls or partitions; made from plaster or wood pulp or other materials and used primarily to form the interior walls of houses
translation_zh: n. (护)墙板
example: 这个wallboard（noun）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. nut of any of various walnut trees having a wrinkled two-lobed seed with a hard shell; n. hard dark-brown wood of any of various walnut trees; used especially for furniture and paneling; n. any of various trees of the genus Juglans
translation_zh: n. 胡桃；[机] 胡桃木
example: 这个胡桃（树）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. have need of; v. hunt or look for; want for a particular reason; v. wish or demand the presence of; v. be without, lack; be deficient in
translation_zh: n. 需要的东西, 缺乏, 贫困, 需要；vt. 要, 希望, 应该, 缺少；vi. 生活困苦, 需要, 缺少
example: 这个需要为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a government ship that is available for waging war
translation_zh: n. 军舰, 战船
example: The warship sailed into the harbor for repairs.

meaning: n. a period of time during which there is armed conflict
translation_zh: n. 战时
example: Many changes occur in society during wartime.

meaning: n. a white person of Anglo-Saxon ancestry who belongs to a Protestant denomination; n. social or solitary hymenopterans typically having a slender body with the abdomen attached by a narrow stalk and having a formidable sting
translation_zh: n. 黄蜂, 胡蜂, 易怒的人, 刻毒的人；[医] 胡蜂, 黄蜂
example: 这个黄蜂为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. any fabric impervious to water; v. make watertight
translation_zh: n. 防水材料；a. 不透水的, 防水的；vt. 使防水
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常不透水的的解释。

meaning: v. lessen the strength of; v. become weaker
translation_zh: vt. 削弱, 减弱, 使虚弱；vi. 变弱, 变软弱
example: 我们需要逐步weaken这个方案。

meaning: r. in a weak or feeble manner or to a minor degree
translation_zh: a. 弱的, 虚弱的；adv. 微弱地, 虚弱地
example: 他软弱地地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s having an abundant supply of money or possessions of value
translation_zh: a. 富有的, 丰裕的, 充分的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常富有的的解释。

meaning: s so lacking in interest as to cause mental weariness
translation_zh: a. 使疲倦的, 使厌倦的, 乏味的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常wearisome（adjective）的解释。

meaning: v exhaust or get tired through overuse or great strain or stress; v lose interest or become bored with something or somebody; s physically and mentally fatigued
translation_zh: a. 疲倦的, 萎靡的, 厌倦的, 厌烦的；vt. 使疲倦, 使厌烦；vi. 疲乏, 生厌, 不耐烦
example: After the long journey, she felt weary.
